programme.desc: 為延續未完的十人餐，肥媽抵買當造海鮮、健康的三色藜麥及矜貴鴨肝，分別煮出「雜錦海鮮大鑊飯」及「煎法國鴨肝伴焦糖蘋果」，惹眾人垂涎。但她還要處理三包鴨血，用攪拌了的鴨血漿燜煮一塊塊的鴨血，煮出一道「鴨血煮鴨血」，還有用西芹、洋蔥、甘筍，以西式的方法燜煮豬腩肉，過程中竟教大家英語生字。肥媽妙用椰皇的特性切開少許椰殼，將蛋白、奶、糖、燕窩放進去，清甜的飯後甜品「椰皇鮮奶燕窩」吸引眾人等着起筷！.

programme.title: 流行都市[粵]
programme.desc: 耳咽管主要負責調節耳壓、引流分泌物，一旦出現問題，便可能演變成耳咽管開放症或阻塞症，惟兩者的病徵、成因與治療方法均截然不同。耳鼻喉科醫生詳釋相關資訊，也會帶來有助舒緩不適的方法。黃劍文、譚偉權作客節目，暢談結伴舉辦音樂會的緣由。音樂會引領觀眾回顧香港音樂劇發展，更破格融入粵曲元素，構思何來？兩人分享與新生代演員合作感受，劍文還預告會挑戰唱粵曲。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie師傅示範「海鮮紅燒豆腐」。.

programme.title: LAW霸女神[粵]

programme.desc: 沅婉欲刺殺大同之際，有人搶先一步叛變，狄奇四人助大同擺平叛軍。大同怒斥狄奇逃獄後竟敢回來偷竊，狄奇蘭花巧舌下仍難平其怒氣，四人作好被殺準備。怎料大同宣布讓狄奇接管昇威鎮，並將沅婉、艾妞、葉天嬌給他作姨太太，還送上愛犬少帥。鎮長裘千差帶狄奇巡鎮，狄奇替鎮民處理紛爭的方法，讓鎮民哭笑不得。細龜三人分別邀請狄奇一聚，趁機給他下馬威，狄奇一一擺平，並反過來宴請三人。三人威嚇狄奇，狄奇二話不說開槍殺人。.

騙中傳奇#10[粵]
programme.desc: 正忠正闢室作試酒場地，因不懂女兒紅特性，糟蹋了整酲美酒。九斤二與玉麟趕至時，忠正巳醉昏，玉麟為替忠正補鑊，到友人杜承康之酒莊一行，事件才完滿解決。布政使作出重賞，但忠正卻以為憑己本事爭取回來。忠正為免忠正再出洋相，使計令他前往杭州驗貨。杭州怡紅院內，寶兒突出現，眾富商要忠正所驗證的，卻是寶兒是否處子之身，忠正雖感為難，但仍能過關，但顧井對寶兒淪落風塵，頓感心痛。顧井為救寶兒，不惜將眾富商打昏。.

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。.

programme.title: 流行都市[粵]
programme.desc: 耳咽管主要負責調節耳壓、引流分泌物，一旦出現問題，便可能演變成耳咽管開放症或阻塞症，惟兩者的病徵、成因與治療方法均截然不同。耳鼻喉科醫生詳釋相關資訊，也會帶來有助舒緩不適的方法。黃劍文、譚偉權作客節目，暢談結伴舉辦音樂會的緣由。音樂會引領觀眾回顧香港音樂劇發展，更破格融入粵曲元素，構思何來？兩人分享與新生代演員合作感受，劍文還預告會挑戰唱粵曲。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie師傅示範「海鮮紅燒豆腐」。.

programme.title: LAW霸女神[粵]
programme.desc: KOL為吸Like，在社交平台舉辦抽獎活動。嘉賓吳業坤本認為犯法，卻想起自己也曾派福利送贈簽名相，慌忙要轉軚！一時錯手將淫褻影片發放到通訊軟件群組，可會觸犯法例？坤哥「衰多口」，令祖儀火起要「動武」。錄取偶像演出片段進行二次創作，並於網上發佈。眾人只着眼於侵犯版權事宜，到律師解答時方知是涉及私隱條例。坤哥諗到頭痛，更笑言想中途離場……部份店舖會將疑似小偷的截圖張貼出來，以警惕公眾，此舉卻可能違法？.

programme.title: 大帥哥#2[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 沅婉欲刺殺大同之際，有人搶先一步叛變，狄奇四人助大同擺平叛軍。大同怒斥狄奇逃獄後竟敢回來偷竊，狄奇蘭花巧舌下仍難平其怒氣，四人作好被殺準備。怎料大同宣布讓狄奇接管昇威鎮，並將沅婉、艾妞、葉天嬌給他作姨太太，還送上愛犬少帥。鎮長裘千差帶狄奇巡鎮，狄奇替鎮民處理紛爭的方法，讓鎮民哭笑不得。細龜三人分別邀請狄奇一聚，趁機給他下馬威，狄奇一一擺平，並反過來宴請三人。三人威嚇狄奇，狄奇二話不說開槍殺人。.

programme.title: 高朋滿座#226[粵]
programme.desc: 大年初一，三妗婆帶著小豬拜年，原來三趁著豬年特意由長洲帶名為「阿金」的小豬，圖將福氣帶來高家，情看到阿金後便愛不釋手。當晚高家即召開會議，商討如何處理阿金。眾人你推我讓，最後一致通過由情親自照顧阿金。.

programme.title: 玉樓春#40[粵/普][PG]
programme.desc: 賈逢源跟梁京冠謀劃扳倒孫遜，決定先除掉孫貴妃。他利用潘才人喪子之事大做文章，找來李太醫指證是孫貴妃令大皇子感染瘟疫而死。林少春為孫貴妃打抱不平，提出疑點，皇上批准召李太醫家人進宮，同時下旨包圍孫府。.

programme.title: 香港遊樂團[粵]
programme.desc: 滕麗名、吳家樂、江欣燕、梁嘉琪邀請張智軒，來到大嶼山的石壁宿舍做義工。幾位義工各司其職，嘉琪與智軒主力洗廁所，家樂、阿滕與欣欣則隨宿友參觀壁畫角。他們欣賞作品後突然畫興大發，自動請纓替宿舍多添兩幅壁畫，過程中最高興的莫過於與小孩子真誠交流。隨後，阿滕與欣欣大展廚藝，獎勵一眾勞苦功高的小畫家。午飯後，家樂與智軒各自領軍與宿友來一場「友誼波」，家樂以大欺小不成，反被對方魚肉？.

programme.title: 香港遊樂團[粵]
programme.desc: 吳家樂、江欣燕、范振鋒到林村做義工，為保育圍村文化出一分力。幾位主持在鄉公所首副主席邦哥帶領下幫忙修建道路，令防空洞得以重見天日。眾人「雞手鴨腳」完成任務，欣欣還在水泥地上留下筆跡。眾人享用林村傳統茶果糕點後到百年古屋尋寶，幫忙將寶物運到文物儲存室，順道欣賞其他文物，如八卦碗、雞宅等，當中一封家書勾起了欣欣對父親的回憶。邦哥細說文物背後的故事，為眾人介紹富歷史價值和快失傳的林村鄉圍村文化。.

programme.title: 香港早晨[粵] 及 環球新聞檔案[粵]
細味文明[粵/英]
programme.desc: 遨遊全世界最受歡迎且充滿美態與魅力的旅遊勝地，欣賞美妙的天然奇景、引人入勝的古蹟、精湛的手工藝和迷人的景色。帶觀眾踏上難忘的旅程，融入夢想旅遊目的地的傳統與歷史裡。.

programme.title: 手匠傳承[粵/韓]
programme.desc: 本集將介紹沙特阿拉伯一種獨特的編織工藝- 「阿爾薩度」.貝都因人用阿爾薩度親手為家庭製作所需的物品, 她們一邊編織布料, 一邊互相分享家人的消息, 阿爾薩度不只是織布技術, 更是一種團結家庭的集體藝術.

programme.title: 文明啟航[粵/英]
programme.desc: 歷史學家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人類歷史上最引人入勝的故事，揭開世界各地鮮為人知的歷史和非凡文物。.

programme.title: 如果這樣生活[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條[粵]
programme.desc: 在雲南大理，黎諾懿繼續協助法籍私房菜大廚預備招待各國來的朋友，終教他明白法國菜要吃多個小時的理由！諾懿煲出水鴨湯讓大家品評，結論竟是各人演技太好？諾懿乘船登上大理唯一有人居住的小島，到一間由曾是互聯網公司強人營辦的民宿，幫忙招待客人，客人卻嫌棄他太吵！工作步伐不需急促，反而令諾懿感到納悶，幸好老闆帶他到市集閒逛，諾懿竟找到適合楊明食用的手信？試過了歸隱田園，諾懿還堅持嚮往田園生活嗎？.

programme.title: 兄弟姊妹去旅行[粵]
programme.desc: 蕭正楠、曹永廉、胡定欣、姚子羚「被組團」去瑞士旅行。兩女豪坐頭等艙，為何阿廉「一支公」坐商務客位？先到中古世紀小城琉森，走上打卡熱點教堂橋Selfie，再到旁邊市集買燒烤食物，兩男不理素食的子羚不停買肉，還取笑她們買了可辟邪的蔬果。乘坐全球首部360度旋轉纜車登上鐵力士山峰，鬥快滑雪兜，阿廉還差點出意外！在特里步湖划艇及燒烤，悠閒地分享旅行經歷，阿蕭有趟旅行後出現長達半年「後遺症」，聽聽他的忠告！.

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷[粵]
programme.desc: 谷主汛文提出與拍檔們圍繞「倫理道德」主題聊天，並以快問快答揭開序幕。她概述倫理學的三大分支概念，並進一步介紹其中的後設倫理學，還以插隊、偽君子等做例子；凱婷感同身受分享友人「講一套做一套」的經歷。回到開場問題，原來可反映眾人的抉擇是根據結果論、義務論或德性倫理學的思考模式。汛文也引述多位哲學家的學說，並帶出「兇手敲門」的思想實驗。她又引領拍檔將視野延伸至東方智慧，從中比較儒家、墨家與道家的學說。.

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV[粵]
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。.

programme.title: 福祿壽訓練學院[粵]
programme.desc: 李龍基對被模仿感榮幸，這集親身亮相學院現場，與扮演他的福祿壽三子同台演唱。分組對決首回合「復刻經典舞台」上演，由專業評審羅冠蘭與觀眾一同打分。阮兆祥派趙頌宜演繹莫文蔚的<呼吸有害>，頌宜表現獲大讚，得分竟因某人而拉低？王祖藍安排鄭詠謙扮曾比特、湯卓堅扮林子祥重演《聲生不息》舞台合唱，最終由於「第三者」出現令人略嫌失望？關嘉敏、葉泓聲獲李思捷指派重現張國榮的「鴛鴦舞王」演出，表演後卻感自責？.

programme.title: 世界養生組織[粵]
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！.

programme.title: Gi味俱全[粵]
programme.desc: 本集的菜式是西洋菜豆腐羹，主持人教大家怎樣吃到幼嫩的西洋菜，而又不用浪費的方法，材料清洗乾淨後，先將部分耐煮的材料放進鍋子裡熬煮，待味道出來後再加入西洋菜及豆腐，煮沸後勾芡，就成為清爽又有飽腹感的菜式.

programme.title: 地球大神秘[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 全新一輯《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及專業的手法，深入拆解世上各種不解謎團［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、極致、禁忌，以及一切等待被發現真相的代號。透過揭開隱藏於挪亞方舟的終極奧秘，得以更了解貫穿世界一切事物的「神秘的祢」，從而在陷入亂局的這一刻，找到如何活得平安及豐盛，以及尋找到永恆不滅的主宰。.

programme.title: 星光魔法[粵/日]
programme.desc: 心愛檸檬與拍檔凱龍找上祭與喵姆，向她們求教星光魔法。檸檬極度怕羞，難以跟陌生人溝通，枉論登台表演。祭找來希娜幫忙，希娜提出讓她代替檸檬登台。看過希娜的表演後，檸檬上網留言表達感受。.

programme.title: Hands Up[粵]
programme.desc: 兒童節目《Hands Up》有「醬汁家族」成員和一眾主持，陪伴大家度過愉快時光。「Kids’ Notes」邀請不同界別人士，跟小朋友分享有趣事物；透過「勇闖小兵團」遊戲，讓孩子們快樂遊玩；運動教練引領大家「Workout 2gether」，鍛練身體；還會透過「Artspiration」，引領孩子了解藝術世界；「My Little Show」開放表演舞台，小朋友到來盡情展示才藝！.

programme.title: 查查林部隊[粵/英]
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。.

programme.title: 2026年王者榮耀KPL年度總決賽·決賽[直播][粵/普]
programme.desc: 「王者榮耀」KPL十周年，兩支北京電競隊在年度總決賽狹路相逢，爭逐榮耀加冕！北京JDG戰隊一路由勝者組強勢推進，明星選手無畏、清融是致勝關鍵。北京WB戰隊從敗者組逆襲而歸，打野暖陽、射手昭珏都是陣中核心。此外，表演嘉賓周深會以歌聲加持「榮耀」殿堂。TVB翡翠台、明珠台接力播映這場BO7大戰，主持張與辰、彭家賢、施焯日、嘉賓羅泳嫻、小編黃瀅仴，聯同兩位電競評述員老星、伍嘉豪，跟觀眾迎接「王者」駕臨！.

programme.title: 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條[粵]
programme.desc: 香港，一個中西薈萃、新舊共融的國際都市，不論吃喝、玩樂、購物都多姿多采。節目中主持人會介紹最新的潮流資訊和生活熱話，為你發掘香港更精彩的一面，講究生活和追求時尚的你絕對不能錯過。.

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。.

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵]
新聞透視[粵]
programme.desc: 《新聞透視》，每周專題報道多段香港以至國際的矚目新聞，聚焦港人最關心的民生話題，並邀請各界人士、學者、專家，一同深入探討箇中來龍去脈。.

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲[粵]
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。.

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。.

programme.title: 渣打優先理財呈獻：Grand住去首爾[粵]
programme.desc: 「Grand住旅行團」又再出發，高海寧、周嘉洛、朱敏瀚會歎住暢遊首爾！主持們會朝聖當地星級餐廳、品嚐頂級韓牛。美食行程外，兩位男生更獲安排與韓國明星兼「健身Icon」金鐘國一同熱血操肌，之後再盡情大啖吃燒肉。三人亦獲安排貼心私人行程，海寧跟陶瓷藝術家來一趟浪漫約會；朱仔體驗精緻西裝訂造，盡顯型男風采；嘉洛則親試頂流韓星同款的專屬造型設計，華麗變身。尊貴的玩味體驗，引領觀眾感受首爾極致奢華的魅力！.

programme.title: 香港旅遊發展局呈獻：香港連場好戲[粵]
programme.desc: 從劇情片中的逆境奮鬥故事，領會香港精神！現已拆卸的九龍城寨，曾有「三不管」的傳奇色彩，兩主持約同演員伍允龍走進電影展覽館，穿梭光影場景與舊日時空交織的「圍城」。砵甸乍街、中環街市等歷史角落，散發着獨特的電影韻味；深入石澳，也可細味《喜劇之王》的追夢與愛情故事。《逆流大叔》於城門河奮力划槳，電影導演陳詠燊訴說創作靈感。《毒舌大狀》為討公義，在前粉嶺裁判法院唇槍舌劍，演員謝君豪憶述實景拍攝法庭戲感受。.

programme.title: 晚間新聞[粵]
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。.

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵]
香港賽馬會特約：J Sport[粵] 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條[粵]
programme.desc: 香港車手方俊宇將夥拍德國名將晏高，征戰澳門大賽車GT世界盃，俊宇從拍檔身上學到甚麼？西班牙球星大衛施華首戰港超聯，助至尊沙田以1比1賽和標準流浪，他還會暢談來港踢波感受。黎志豪當選新一任欖總主席，他提到希望將本港欖球推動到社區，及發展至大灣區。五位健美港將會出戰亞錦賽，備戰情況如何？香港馬術盛典將於1月舉行，法國騎手率先來港交流。另搜羅三鐵世界盃戰報，以及壁球公開賽、粵港澳大灣區匹克球賽記招花絮。.

programme.title: 飛虎3壯志英雄#21[粵][PG]
programme.desc: Mike涉嫌一宗謀殺案而被通緝，Mike向Don堅稱被陷害；博文問敏莉有否見過Mike，她稱沒有；素筠向敏莉表示自己患有漸凍症，希望她不要告訴博文；嘉軒和家寶調查許森的背景，發現收養他的濟群會有問題，於是再深入調查。.

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。.

programme.title: 地球大神秘[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 全新一輯《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及專業的手法，深入拆解世上各種不解謎團［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、極致、禁忌，以及一切等待被發現真相的代號。透過揭開隱藏於挪亞方舟的終極奧秘，得以更了解貫穿世界一切事物的「神秘的祢」，從而在陷入亂局的這一刻，找到如何活得平安及豐盛，以及尋找到永恆不滅的主宰。.

programme.title: 如果這樣生活[粵]
programme.desc: 在雲南大理，黎諾懿繼續協助法籍私房菜大廚預備招待各國來的朋友，終教他明白法國菜要吃多個小時的理由！諾懿煲出水鴨湯讓大家品評，結論竟是各人演技太好？諾懿乘船登上大理唯一有人居住的小島，到一間由曾是互聯網公司強人營辦的民宿，幫忙招待客人，客人卻嫌棄他太吵！工作步伐不需急促，反而令諾懿感到納悶，幸好老闆帶他到市集閒逛，諾懿竟找到適合楊明食用的手信？試過了歸隱田園，諾懿還堅持嚮往田園生活嗎？.

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼[粵]
programme.desc: 粵語「㜺鬼」傳神，博大精深，香港不少俗話亦源自廣東省各地。㜺鬼大使麥美恩遂將探索版圖擴展至中國，並找來鄧智堅、戴祖儀、許文軒加入「㜺鬼導賞團」，深入廣州等內地城市，發掘相關的有趣典故及出處。專業粵語及典故專家亦會現身，追源溯古引經據典，揭示貼地粵語的魅力所在。此外，喜歡扮鬼扮馬的鄧智堅還於節目化身單身宅男，透過他追求一眾「女神」的過程，讓大家了解多個俗語及術語的含意。.

programme.title: 2026英雄聯盟全球總決賽冠亞軍決賽[直播][粵/普]
programme.desc: 2026「英雄聯盟」全球大賽在美國舉行，韓國LCK戰區第一種子Gen.G、中國LPL戰區第二種子BLG，從瑞士輪、淘汰賽階段殺出重圍，會師總決賽戰場。Gen.G中路明星選手Chovy與BLG中路左手戰將Knight，迎來「左右手」巔峰對決，力爭帶領戰隊登上榮譽之巔。主持戴祖儀、林沚羿、彭家賢、電競評述員老星、彭泳熙、嘉賓羅泳嫻、小編吳文懿，坐鎮TVB翡翠台，由開幕表演到BO5「中韓大戰」全程直擊！.

programme.title: 2026英雄聯盟全球總決賽冠亞軍決賽[直播][粵/普]
programme.desc: 2026「英雄聯盟」全球大賽在美國舉行，韓國LCK戰區第一種子Gen.G、中國LPL戰區第二種子BLG，從瑞士輪、淘汰賽階段殺出重圍，會師總決賽戰場。Gen.G中路明星選手Chovy與BLG中路左手戰將Knight，迎來「左右手」巔峰對決，力爭帶領戰隊登上榮譽之巔。主持戴祖儀、林沚羿、彭家賢、電競評述員老星、彭泳熙、嘉賓羅泳嫻、小編吳文懿，坐鎮TVB翡翠台，由開幕表演到BO5「中韓大戰」全程直擊！.

programme.title: 食得好健康[粵]
programme.desc: 如有腹脹、便秘等問題，牛蒡是大家的腸胃救星！牛蒡含有豐富膳食纖維，有助促進腸道健康。市面上可找到出產自中國與日本的牛蒡，二者有甚麼分別？牛蒡口感粗糙，煒哥巧妙地將之切絲，烹調「涼拌牛蒡」和「牛蒡豬肉卷」，皆容易入口。「游生私房菜」，廚藝專家梁雅琳亦以切絲做法，製成「牛蒡伴鮮果吞拿魚」，味道清新。盈盈善用茶水間的電飯煲，煮出「牛蒡蒟蒻飯」，有何竅門？來到減肥結算的日子，希望「食住瘦」的波波能否達標？.

programme.title: Do姐有問題[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 「星夢」歌手同門較量，周柏豪夥拍連詩雅，對戰謝東閔與戴祖儀。日本拉麵文化博大精深，主打魚介湯底的拉麵店內多個虹吸式咖啡壺，有甚麼作用？雜貨店內每件商品僅得一件，卻非二手貨物，兩隊須猜出店舖貨源。泰式按摩花款多多，一款條狀物件有何另類用途？冰島一場所因擺放「神聖之物」，吸引不少充滿好奇心的旅客；兩隊競猜箇中「最大」與「最小」，Do姐見眾人一臉蠢相，大方給予貼士！哪一隊能獲幸運之神眷顧，贏得高額獎金？.

programme.title: 十築台灣[粵/普]
programme.desc: 台灣不乏宏偉的表演藝術中心。臺中的大型歌劇院出自日本建築師手筆，內部空間的玻璃幕牆引入自然光影與風景，亦運用視覺將戶外延伸至室內。劇院的曲形牆身建築講究，三個劇場的聲學設計絕不馬虎；樓頂設計與歌劇院中心連成一線，充滿日式美感，成打卡勝地。高雄衛武營由軍事基地轉成文藝建築，表演場館出自荷蘭建築師之手，外觀有如陸地上的一艘船。四個表演場館各有不同氛圍和聲樂效果，欣賞建築師在場館外觀、廣場設計上的特色。.

programme.title: 十築台灣[粵/普]
programme.desc: 台灣近年興起私人美術館浪潮，先跟小牟走進南投一座隱藏於林間的私人美術館，欣賞美術館配合土地原有地形的建築特色，邊走過長廊，邊感受植物給人沉澱心靈的感覺。淡水一座小巧精緻的私人美術館，外觀由四條柱支撐方形的玻璃建築，自然景觀倒影在玻璃牆上。藝術與建築匯合，令室內空間細節與藝術畫作配合得宜，更能感受藝術。綠意盎然的山上有一座純白的美術館，充滿着自由氣息，遊走於沒有限制、能隨心所欲的空間，閒適舒暢。.

programme.title: 星夢頻道[粵/日]
programme.desc: 閃亮宿突然下大雪，星夢頻道樂園也因此關門。為協助虹之咲突破設計的瓶頸，她找上未來求助，還帶未來到虛擬星夢頻道樂園遊玩。四眼哥哥見狀，便乾脆將虛擬樂園對外開放一天，吸引大家到場暢遊一番。.

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2[粵/普]
喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2[粵/普]
多啦A夢[粵]
programme.desc: 大雄遇上正在送貨的胖虎。胖虎見到大雄，便把全部貨品塞了給大雄，要大雄替他送貨。大雄聽到父母說要替他找補習老師，情急之下承諾會努力改善成績。但是大雄三分鐘熱度，更想出了一個鬼主意。.

programme.title: 古典樂之星[粵/日]
programme.desc: 貝多芬仍拿不定主意，是否加入莫札特一行，參加比賽。在機緣巧合下，貝多芬來到李斯特老家，在那裡，他看見李斯特作為傳統藝能世家之子的一面。縱使李斯特有意繼承家業，但複雜的身世卻令他難以登上舞台。.

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊[粵]
programme.desc: 重慶的武隆仙女山有個容易登峰的觀景塔，看完美景更可沿滑梯滑下。再於一望無際的草原野餐，仙女山名從何來？盲盒再現，還一次過抽出三個目的地？首站張家界，走入國家森林公園，乘搭全球最長的戶外電梯，約一分鐘即上山！踏上全國首座高空玻璃橋，欣賞大峽谷的獨有地貌，再以高空滑索穿梭其中，有主持嫌慢，拍檔卻不斷大叫？除了自然美景外，原來張家界還有「夜蒲點」可看表演，主持更被臨時拉上台跳舞，只因某人作怪…….

programme.title: 香港美食匠人[粵]
programme.desc: 西貢區海鮮食肆林立，大廚鍾貴華憑高超廚藝、低調作風殺出重圍，更助菜館「摘星」！芷珊約同星級食客陳煒、林澄光聚餐，椒鹽鮑魚外脆內嫩、金湯魚蓉羹鮮香無比，隱藏匠人心思與功夫。陳方藤將沾麵專門店引入香港，並堅持還原正宗和風滋味。湯底、麵條都是靈魂，主持從舌尖感受「拉麵陳」對日式拉麵的熱情。為炮製招牌酒香烤雞，餐廳主理人郭智恒對食材一絲不苟，竟要求以特定飼料養雞？他還善用侍酒師經驗，美酒搭佳餚，層次昇華！.

programme.title: 香港美食匠人[粵]
programme.desc: 中環老字號清湯腩店，主理人潘國興多年來堅持以心製腩，至今仍不斷改良配方。這名老闆自言懶理網上火熱負評，但當芷珊問到可會認同自己性格有點「串」，他會如何回應？軟殼龍蝦是港產優質食材，出品獲國際性環保組織認證。負責人為龍蝦營造快樂養殖環境，飼料亦講究營養多樣化。據說可能是全港最美味的薯條？女主理人不惜花近十天時間備料製作。她本從事金融業，後因患病而決心追夢。談及在法國菜師父身上獲益良多，她更一度哽咽。.

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季[粵/普]
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過\"潮養生活\"與\"中醫歷練\"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。.

programme.title: Gi味俱全[粵]
programme.desc: Gigi姐家裡有一道常做的菜式「檸檬雞翼」，深受她的孩子和朋友歡迎；原來是她當年從資深前輩馮峰家裡偷師，再用自己的簡易方法來炮製。由於配料很多，Gigi姐想出了容易記住的分量比例，方便各位朋友跟著做。.

programme.title: 甜心先生[粵]
programme.desc: 常言道美滿生活容易令人心廣「體胖」，今集嘉賓林夏薇今年投入幸福「少奶」生活之後，對於甜品的鍾愛依然絲毫不減，偏偏夏薇卻一直保持令人羨慕的完美體態，甚至揚言仍在尋求增肥方法！面對著「食極唔肥」的夏薇，阿古(古嘉俊)亦決定毫不保留，運用榛子、栗子、冧酒等豐富材料，炮製一款滋味十足的「冧酒榛子栗子車厘子撻」，盡情滿足她對美味甜品的渴求。.

programme.title: 星光魔法[粵/日]
programme.desc: 喵姆魔法失控，把自己、祭和檸檬送到魔法界，幸好被喵爺救起。喵姆受不了喵爺囉嗦，生氣跑走。檸檬發現喵爺的相簿，喵姆發現喵爺記得她愛吃馬卡龍，感到窩心，並決定用星光魔法向他傳達謝意。.

programme.title: Hands Up[粵]
programme.desc: 兒童節目《Hands Up》有「醬汁家族」成員和一眾主持，陪伴大家度過愉快時光。「Kids’ Notes」邀請不同界別人士，跟小朋友分享有趣事物；透過「勇闖小兵團」遊戲，讓孩子們快樂遊玩；運動教練引領大家「Workout 2gether」，鍛練身體；還會透過「Artspiration」，引領孩子了解藝術世界；「My Little Show」開放表演舞台，小朋友到來盡情展示才藝！.

programme.title: 屁屁偵探[粵/日]
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！.

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子[粵/日]
programme.desc: 小丸子為了晚餐吃到漢堡排，想在課堂上被老師揀中答問題，卻因太遲舉手而失敗，更因肚皮打鼓而出醜。友藏決心凡事靠自己，當他開始變得獨立，嫲嫲卻因為生活中缺少與友藏交流而感到寂寞。.

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲[粵]
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。.

programme.title: 財經透視[粵]
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。.

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。.

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵]
星期日檔案[粵]
programme.desc: 《星期日檔案》，每周聚焦於熱門新聞人物，特寫報道；或以人性化角度，透過走訪社會不同階層，不同界別人士，深入探討大眾關切的政治、社會民生等議題。.

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV[粵]
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。.

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。.

programme.title: BCT 強積金呈獻：弊傢伙！有嘢唔見咗﹗[粵]
programme.desc: AI功能越來越強大，如果畫面中的關鍵細節被AI悄然抹走，大家是可憑記憶找回缺失的部分，還是集體陷入「腦霧」狀態？陳展鵬率領甄敏芳、林智樂，一起主持問答遊戲節目《弊傢伙！有嘢唔見咗！》，每集邀請兩隊星級藝人鬥智較量，爭奪獎金。節目中，AI化身「記憶擦膠」，篡改大眾熟悉的神劇、經典音樂、地標場景等，隊員要憑記憶尋回被抹走的真相。經過四個回合的腦力激戰，累積分數較高的隊伍將可挑戰贏取Jackpot大獎！.

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2[粵]
programme.desc: 戀愛真人騷《女神配對計劃》火熱回歸，第二季戀愛戰場全面升級！「金牌媒人」Bob林盛斌招募全球男士，為女神何沛珈、郭珮文、陳若思、俞可程、阮嘉敏開展戀愛配對。求愛勇者接受心動撳燈、五角枱約會等挑戰，各出奇謀冧女神。一對一親密遊戲引爆心跳警報，還有隱藏女神加入戰團，火花進一步升溫……更多求愛考驗來臨，勇者們力求走到最後，攻陷女神心！此外，上季五位女神與星級嘉賓們輪流成為「花生團」，直擊女神約會實況。.

programme.title: 及時雨信貸呈獻：一周星星[粵]
programme.desc: 訪談節目《一周星星》，每集邀請星級藝人、界別名人，與區永權、許文軒、王鎮泉等娛樂主播，分享新近工作企劃，談論電影、電視、演唱會相關的特別話題，尤其是網民與圈中朋友關心熱議的人和事！周邊訊息如此多，節目特設「Fact Check」核實環節，由嘉賓親自回應各式各樣的傳聞，讓當事人說清楚箇中真相！.

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music[粵]
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高質音樂平台，一眾歌手有展示音樂實力的機會之餘，也可讓樂迷更深入了解歌手的音樂故事。節目邀請「人氣」歌手擔任嘉賓，由嘉賓親自挑選其喜歡的新舊作品，並即場演唱，分享喜愛曲目。而一些樂壇新面孔亦會亮相，透過互動交流，展現音樂潛力。此外，每集緊貼「勁歌金榜」最新形勢，還會帶來不同歌手、創作人或製作人的訪問，跟觀眾暢談作品，以至音樂業界的人和事。.

programme.title: 美食新聞周報[粵]
programme.desc: 黃嘉雯、蔡景行、施焯日等主持親往熱搜餐廳試味，推介自駕覓食好去處，發掘各區「掃街」名物、名人愛店，驗證網上「抵食」傳聞；又會相約居港的外國人，到訪經他們認證的家鄉風味食肆。名廚、食評家、美食KOL、各區地膽及的士司機亦會帶路「搵食」，帶來專業推介；識食之人還會細說美食典故。節目精選《美食新聞報道》介紹的多間「人氣」餐廳，力推當中招牌美食，並會速遞美食優惠，讓觀眾即時掌握最滋味、抵食的飲食情報。.

programme.title: 晚間新聞[粵]
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。.

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵]
飛虎3壯志英雄#22[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 許森假意送李惠蘭和蔡肇培離開，途中惠蘭被殺手殺害，肇培大受打擊。在許森勸說下，蔡肇培終於答應製作DH2。杜文彬將股份轉給妹妹，使她成為裕天董事會主席。杜以盈請高子樂購買竊聽器來監聽杜文彬的一舉一動。.

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。.

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季[粵/普]
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過\"潮養生活\"與\"中醫歷練\"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。.

programme.title: Gi味俱全[粵]
programme.desc: Gigi姐家裡有一道常做的菜式「檸檬雞翼」，深受她的孩子和朋友歡迎；原來是她當年從資深前輩馮峰家裡偷師，再用自己的簡易方法來炮製。由於配料很多，Gigi姐想出了容易記住的分量比例，方便各位朋友跟著做。.

programme.title: 甜心先生[粵]
programme.desc: 常言道美滿生活容易令人心廣「體胖」，今集嘉賓林夏薇今年投入幸福「少奶」生活之後，對於甜品的鍾愛依然絲毫不減，偏偏夏薇卻一直保持令人羨慕的完美體態，甚至揚言仍在尋求增肥方法！面對著「食極唔肥」的夏薇，阿古(古嘉俊)亦決定毫不保留，運用榛子、栗子、冧酒等豐富材料，炮製一款滋味十足的「冧酒榛子栗子車厘子撻」，盡情滿足她對美味甜品的渴求。.

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊[粵]
programme.desc: 重慶的武隆仙女山有個容易登峰的觀景塔，看完美景更可沿滑梯滑下。再於一望無際的草原野餐，仙女山名從何來？盲盒再現，還一次過抽出三個目的地？首站張家界，走入國家森林公園，乘搭全球最長的戶外電梯，約一分鐘即上山！踏上全國首座高空玻璃橋，欣賞大峽谷的獨有地貌，再以高空滑索穿梭其中，有主持嫌慢，拍檔卻不斷大叫？除了自然美景外，原來張家界還有「夜蒲點」可看表演，主持更被臨時拉上台跳舞，只因某人作怪…….

programme.title: 香港美食匠人[粵]
programme.desc: 西貢區海鮮食肆林立，大廚鍾貴華憑高超廚藝、低調作風殺出重圍，更助菜館「摘星」！芷珊約同星級食客陳煒、林澄光聚餐，椒鹽鮑魚外脆內嫩、金湯魚蓉羹鮮香無比，隱藏匠人心思與功夫。陳方藤將沾麵專門店引入香港，並堅持還原正宗和風滋味。湯底、麵條都是靈魂，主持從舌尖感受「拉麵陳」對日式拉麵的熱情。為炮製招牌酒香烤雞，餐廳主理人郭智恒對食材一絲不苟，竟要求以特定飼料養雞？他還善用侍酒師經驗，美酒搭佳餚，層次昇華！.

programme.title: 香港美食匠人[粵]
programme.desc: 中環老字號清湯腩店，主理人潘國興多年來堅持以心製腩，至今仍不斷改良配方。這名老闆自言懶理網上火熱負評，但當芷珊問到可會認同自己性格有點「串」，他會如何回應？軟殼龍蝦是港產優質食材，出品獲國際性環保組織認證。負責人為龍蝦營造快樂養殖環境，飼料亦講究營養多樣化。據說可能是全港最美味的薯條？女主理人不惜花近十天時間備料製作。她本從事金融業，後因患病而決心追夢。談及在法國菜師父身上獲益良多，她更一度哽咽。.

programme.title: 十築台灣[粵/普]
programme.desc: 台灣不乏宏偉的表演藝術中心。臺中的大型歌劇院出自日本建築師手筆，內部空間的玻璃幕牆引入自然光影與風景，亦運用視覺將戶外延伸至室內。劇院的曲形牆身建築講究，三個劇場的聲學設計絕不馬虎；樓頂設計與歌劇院中心連成一線，充滿日式美感，成打卡勝地。高雄衛武營由軍事基地轉成文藝建築，表演場館出自荷蘭建築師之手，外觀有如陸地上的一艘船。四個表演場館各有不同氛圍和聲樂效果，欣賞建築師在場館外觀、廣場設計上的特色。.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: Life's Journey
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of history's greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Discover the world's largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spain's Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the region’s wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Learn how one of the world's most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries.

programme.title: America's Wild Border: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its prey’s heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: Navigate the ocean’s vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: Wild Latin America
programme.desc: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whale’s life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

programme.title: Wild Latin America
programme.desc: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where it’s mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta’s loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Chart the lion’s nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: Into the Wild India
programme.desc: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv’s hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: Life's Journey
programme.desc: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal’s legacy. But it’s not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa’s mating game.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: At the water’s edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. It’s time to breed and they must find a burrow before the females arrive.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: New Zealand’s West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries and the life that thrives within them.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: Spring on New Zealand’s east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. They’ve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives difficult for them. Only the strongest will survive to carry forward their legacy.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: New Zealand’s isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand’s Creepiest Crawlies.

programme.title: Alaskan Summer
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to August, Alaska becomes a paradise for it’s wildlife.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the team's plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks
programme.desc: Bonaire’s fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse marine habitat.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks
programme.desc: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, it’s easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks
programme.desc: The Bahamas is known as the “underwater movie capital of the world”. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters, leaving behind a host of cinematic shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it’s not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It’s actually a diver’s paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffe’s demise becomes a source of life for the region’s vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the region’s species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the city’s shrinking wetlands.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge
programme.desc: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondie’s love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge
programme.desc: Join the frantic dash to cash in on July’s salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBoi's food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown.

programme.title: In for the Kill
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Sirga the lion, whose human pal, Val, has been by her side since she was an orphaned cub. See Loki the raven entertain his BFF Elliott, cuddle with Hugger the stingray, and see why Trish and Garri the koala are like family.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal
programme.desc: Do rounds on the ranch that Albert the camel runs with his human friend Alex, then check in with Herbie the wallaby as he gets pampered by his pal Fleur. Cause a little chaos with Quincy the quoll and hang ten with Chupacabra the surfing goat.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Though Africa’s three big cats—the lion, leopard, and cheetah—live side by side, each has evolved a specialised set of hunting strategies that keep them from colliding. Take an in-depth look at the lives and stories of these iconic apex predators.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdoms
programme.desc: Discover how Europe’s best architecture has created sanctuaries for some of the continent's rarest species. Journey to France, Scotland, and Spain, where seals, birds, newts, wildcats, and snakes thrive among ancient landmarks at the water’s edge.

programme.title: Europe's Wild Kingdoms
programme.desc: Witness animal drama among Europe’s most dramatic peaks. Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx, and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard that’s cleverly adapting to climate change in the Pyrenees.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Storm into a new suburb, where the wranglers keep deadly snakes from slipping into family homes. Watch as Stu and Liv pull an eastern brown from a job site, Jess and Dan expel a python from a shed, and Mick and Adele evict a red belly from a bedroom.

programme.title: Life's Journey
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Explore beautiful Heidelberg Castle whose ruins stand in imposing wonder beside the river Neckar in Western Germany. Surrounded by a protected nature reserve, the castle is home to birds of prey and acts as a spawning ground for nearby amphibians.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Travel to a centuries-old French fortress, home to some of history's greatest empires. Carcassone, once a center of wealth and culture, is now a haven for wildlife. Birds, wild boar, and armies of insects endure in its bountiful surroundings.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Discover the world's largest castle carved into a cave. Predjama, in Slovenia, has provided protection not only for its Medieval human inhabitants, but also serves as a haven for the birds, boars, and mountain goats that live in the region.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Tour the marvelous Alhambra, a must-see fortress in Spain's Grenada region. Today this world heritage site acts as a refuge for the region’s wildlife. With its many streams and fountains, Alhambra serves amphibian, fish, and bird alike.

programme.title: Wild Castles
programme.desc: Learn how one of the world's most spectacular structures, Neuschwanstein castle, and its surrounding forests have become home base for many creatures. From the Alpine ibex to the majestic swans, this castle has been a natural haven for centuries.

programme.title: America's Wild Border: Northern Exposure
programme.desc: Trail Atlantic puffins, Prairie rattlesnakes, Alaskan caribou and other animals as they travel across the international boundary between the U.S. and Canada. See how they can move from safety to target by crossing a line they had no say in creating.

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: Stalk the seas with sharks as they hunt using heightened senses and killer instincts. Watch a whitetip reef shark put its electrical sensors to work finding its prey’s heartbeat, and the pelagic thresher shark stun its quarry with its whiplike tail.

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: Navigate the ocean’s vast distances, depths, and darkness with nomadic sharks that thrive in the blue emptiness. Meet a lone blue shark traversing stormy Atlantic seas, and hundreds of hammerheads returning to their Pacific island breeding ground.

programme.title: Planet Shark
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: Wild Latin America
programme.desc: Follow the first months of a newborn humpback whale’s life in the waters off the Pacific Coast of Columbia. See how his mother nurtures him through sickness, supports his body, protects him under attack, and prepares him for an epic journey.

programme.title: Wild Latin America
programme.desc: Travel deep into the Columbian rainforest, where it’s mating season for one of the most clever monkey species in the world. Witness the most important time of year for male squirrel monkeys that have been bulking up to impress females for months.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta’s loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Chart the lion’s nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives
programme.desc: Navigate the forest with a tiny cub, watch young adults claim their territory, and witness the inevitable exile of aging hunters. Discover how instinct and stealth help the tiger survive in its solitary world, where every decision carries risk.

programme.title: Into the Wild India
programme.desc: One of the most iconic animals on Earth stalks the jungles of India: the Bengal Tiger. Over the course of a single day, we follow the fortunes of one mother and her three young cubs. She must provide enough food for her family to stay alive.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Aussie Snake Wranglers: Deadly Pursuit
programme.desc: Respond to danger on a rural property with Mick and Adele, who brave a fired-up brown snake. Tread carefully as Jess and Dan extract a python from a play area, and get spooked when a chicken-hunting python squashes Liv’s hand during a tense rescue.

programme.title: Life's Journey
programme.desc: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal’s legacy. But it’s not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa’s mating game.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: At the water’s edge a brave group of male penguins gather, preparing to make the dangerous journey ashore. With many threats ahead, there is safety in number and these petite penguins have important business to attend. It’s time to breed and they must find a burrow before the females arrive.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: New Zealand’s West Coast is like nowhere else on Earth. From glacier-covered mountains to rain-drenched native forests to rough frigid seas, the landscape defies belief. Isolated from the rest of the world, this strip of almost untouched wilderness hides a host of endemic animals. Evolutionary castaways, every one of them is a rare ecological jewel. From alpine parrots and shy penguins to mammal-like kiwis and ancient eels. To survive the conditions the wildlife here has to be hardy, cunning and resourceful. A journey along the West Coast reveals the beauty of this land, and the trials and tribulations of the wildlife that live here.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: In New Zealand, two wild fortresses protect the vulnerable native animals: One a remote island protected by a moat of saltwater, the other a hilltop citadel surrounded by a predator-proof barrier. This is the story of these delicate sanctuaries and the life that thrives within them.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: Spring on New Zealand’s east coast is a time of promise for the New Zealand Fur Seal and the Norther Royal Albatross. They’ve returned to their land to breed. But harsh terrain, fickle weather and hungry predators will conspire to make lives difficult for them. Only the strongest will survive to carry forward their legacy.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: New Zealand’s isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand’s Creepiest Crawlies.

programme.title: Alaskan Summer
programme.desc: Nearly 20 hours of sunlight a day feed the season of abundance. Warmth unlocks water from the glaciers, ice caves and waterfalls. The water crashes into countless streams of the Inside Passage, feeding forest and wildlife alike. From June to August, Alaska becomes a paradise for it’s wildlife.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the team's plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks
programme.desc: Bonaire’s fringing reef is home to thousands of species of corals, fish and other marine animals. It is also home to a collection of stunning shipwrecks. These wrecks evolve over time, becoming artificial reefs that support an incredibly diverse marine habitat.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks
programme.desc: The Florida Keys is the first line of defence for the southern US. With a rich naval history and a coastal lifestyle, it’s easy to believe locals who claim these waters are home to as many as 1000 shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks
programme.desc: The Bahamas is known as the “underwater movie capital of the world”. Hollywood has been coming here for decades, making epic movies and TV shows in its crystal clear waters, leaving behind a host of cinematic shipwrecks.

programme.title: Reef Wrecks
programme.desc: This island of the coast of Honduras stands out as a vacation resort hot spot. But it’s not just the sun and sand that brings the tourists in droves. It’s actually a diver’s paradise with shipwrecks scattered from all corners of the the island.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Winter in Marakele National Park is one of the scarcest, but also most plentiful, times of the year. See how a giraffe’s demise becomes a source of life for the region’s vultures, whose survival depends on the decaying flesh of animals like these.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Cape Town, South Africa is home to twenty types of frogs, but many are threatened by urban development. Meet a variety of the region’s species as we follow western leopard toads on their tenuous journey to breed in the city’s shrinking wetlands.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons
programme.desc: Once superabundant, African Elephant populations have declined drastically due to hunting. Get an in-depth look into the lives of the most powerful land mammals on the planet, and see what parks like Addo and Tembe are doing to preserve their future.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge
programme.desc: Wake up post-hibernation with 7 ravenous bears as Stage 1 of the competition kicks off. Battle wolves with new mom BoldFace, see tiny Stomper vie for power and Blondie’s love, and stand back as grizzled vet Bernie brawls with clueless teen Casanova.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge
programme.desc: Join the frantic dash to cash in on July’s salmon run with the Stage 1 winners and some tough new recruits. Tag along on BigBoi's food-finding road trip, welcome QuadMom and RedBack to the feast, and see if BoldFace can keep her surviving cub safe.

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Alaska's Big Bear Challenge
programme.desc: Bundle up as an icy October storm complicates the race to the finish line. See Big Boi bounce after a stumble before tragedy hits QuadMom, and cheer as fan fave BoldFace hits her stride despite her clingy kid, Raccoon. But who will wear the crown.

programme.title: In for the Kill
programme.desc: Marvel at the clever ways predators use cunning, agility, and breakneck speed when taking down prey. Witness luring behaviours and see how some killers hide in plain sight, while others put weaponry or chemical warfare to work to bring dinner home.

Baogu Produces
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: Napping Kid
programme.desc: Siu-yu, a financial analyst who has been working to complete a budget analyst for an investment bank, finds that a file containing confidential information has been mysteriously deleted. Soon after, her boss, John, receives a ransom email from someone called K Kidnapper, demanding just $190,000 worth of ransom. The ransom must be paid in 3 days, otherwise they will share the information to public. Under a detective's secret investigation, everyone could be the suspect..

programme.title: Better Days
programme.desc: On the cusp of the competitive national college entrance exams, Nian, a 17-year-old schoolgirl becomes the target of school bullying after a fellow classmate committed suicide. She later discovers an unlikely ally in Bei, an orphaned street youth. He becomes her protector and they form a unique bond that is soon tested when they are both implicated in a murder.

programme.title: The Rising Star
programme.desc: How did a late-night street shoot ignite Renci Yeung's dream of becoming an actress? Describing herself as a blend of conflicting rational and emotional sides, she found an outlet for her emotions through acting. How does she calmly face scrutiny and criticism from the public when taking on daring roles? Ten years into her career, this rising talent keeps cherishing every hard-won opportunity and moving forward with a free-spirited attitude and the same initial thrill for acting that first ignited her passion.

programme.title: Life is Beautiful
programme.desc: Suddenly learning she is terminally ill, 'Se-yeon' asks her husband, 'Jin-bong', the absurd task of helping her find her first love, and he unwillingly joins her search. Along their journey, 'Se-yeon' and 'Jin-bong' are reminded of the most glittering, beautiful moments of their lives.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: Since the beginning of time, there existed in the world three clans; human, god and demon. As everything was destroyed during the great battle, Nuwa (Goddess of Works) used 36,500 magic boulders to repair Heaven. One of them fell accidentally down onto Earth and landed on the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits on an island far across the Eastern Sea. Over thousands of years, the magic boulder absorbed the energies of Heaven and Earth and the sacred lights of the Sun and Moon. A godly creature was nurtured inside the stone-egg and a full-grown monkey burst out from it one day. When the Patriarch Subodhi passed by on his way to collect herbs in the Mountain, he came upon the monkey. Impressed by his exceptional wit and godly he took the monkey back to the Divine Cave of Three Stars in Mountain Mi to teach him the Way and called him Sun Wukong..

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Grand Maison Paris
programme.desc: After their restaurant 'Grand Maison Tokyo' earned a Michelin three-star, Natsuki Obana and Rinko Hayami venture to Paris to open 'Grand Maison Paris,' aiming to become the first Asian chefs to achieve the same honor. However, they face cultural challenges and intense pressure in a city filled with culinary masters. Following a mishap at a gala dinner, Obana makes a pact with his former mentor: he will leave France if they don't earn three stars in the next Michelin evaluation. Can Obana and his team overcome these obstacles to achieve their dream.

programme.title: Integrity
programme.desc: The multi-year ICAC investigation into the Lida Conglomerate is on the brink of collapse after the CEO's disappearance and the whistleblower's fleeing to Australia. To salvage the case, a top ICAC agent teams with a fellow investigator (who happens to be his estranged wife) and risks their lives to bring the witness back to Hong Kong.

programme.title: Artisan spirit in films: Fagara
programme.desc: After her father died, a Hong Kong girl discovers she has two hitherto unknown sisters, one in Taipei and one in Chongqing. To settle her father's debt, she must reunite with them to run the family's hot pot restaurant. While the androgynous Taipei sister is plagued by her toxic relationship with her mother, the fashionista sister from Chongqing is trying to fend off her grandmother's pressure to get married. Meanwhile, she is striving to unshackle herself from her ex-boyfriend in order to start a new relationship.

programme.title: CRISIS NEGOTIATORS
programme.desc: Negotiator expert Cheuk Man Wai unexpectedly becomes the prime suspect in a murder case. Forced into a corner, he occupies the police station, taking officers hostage, and demands negotiations with the former negotiator Tse Ka Chun. With Tse's expertise in psychological manipulation and Cheuk's exceptional skills, they engage in a battle of wits. As the verbal sparring deepens, their positions and mindsets gradually change...This film is adapted from the American movie 'The Negotiator'.

programme.title: Unfinished Girl
programme.desc: He Wei and Xiao Feng are a perfect couple. One day, her younger sister, Xiao Ke, discovers the man who murdered her parents is He Wei, and she invites him back to her home..

programme.title: The Medium
programme.desc: A horrifying story of a shaman's inheritance in the Isan region of Thailand. What could be possessing a family member might not be the Goddess they make it out to be. A documentary team follows Nim, a shaman based in Northern Thai, the Isan area, and encounters her niece Mink showing strange symptoms that seem to be of inheritance of shamanism. The team decides to follow Mink, hoping to capture the shaman lineage passing on to the next generation, but her bizarre behavior becomes more extreme.

programme.title: Accident
programme.desc: A self-styled “accident choreographer,” the Brain is a professional hitman who kills his victims by trapping them in well crafted “accidents” that look like unfortunate mishaps but are in fact perfectly staged acts of crime. Perennially plagued with guilt, he is also suspicious and morbid by nature. The recent avalanche of memories of his lost wife does not make things any easier. After one mission accidentally goes wrong, causing the life of one of his men, the Brain is convinced that this accident has been choreographed: someone is out there plotting to terminate him and his team. He becomes increasingly paranoid, walking on the thin line between reality and delusion..

programme.title: Love On A Diet
programme.desc: Mini Mo becomes a fatty when her boyfriend went abroad ten years ago. She meets Fatso in the time of adversity. When Fatso learns the true story behind Mini's depression..

programme.title: Let’s Go Karaoke
programme.desc: Yakuza member Narita is consumed by only one thing: how to survive his boss' annual karaoke competition. Desperate to avoid his boss' cruel and unusual punishment for losing, Narita recruits junior high school choir member Oka to teach him how to sing. The trouble is, Narita is impossibly hopeless as a singer. The stakes may be low, but Yamashita Nobuhiro's deadpan approach to an unlikely friendship and Ayano Go's hilariously self-deprecating performance make this a winning comedy that will inspire you to hit the karaoke box. Rarely has the butchering beloved pop classics ever been funnier.

programme.title: Dot 2 Dot
programme.desc: Chung returns from Canada to a drastically transformed Hong Kong and hoping to capture the city in his childhood years, graffitis a cryptic diagram near every subway station, in the form of dot-to-dot games. Soon they are discovered by Xue, a Putonghua teacher from Changchun determined to solve these riddles as she immerses herself in our city's culture and history..

programme.title: I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change
programme.desc: I Love You, You're Perfect, Now Change! is a musical comedy with a twist of Hong Kong sentiment, adapted from the hugely popular Broadway Musical of the same title. The original musical premiered Off-Broadway in 1996, and has been running for 23 years. The Hong Kong-based Windmill Grass Theatre adapted the musical and premiered in Hong Kong in 2005. The show had its fifth run in 2017 and had sold out each time. This movie version features 12 vignettes. An ensemble cast of over 60 well-known Hong Kong actors, singers and dancers will be performing multiple hilarious musical numbers that explore one central theme in life – love.

programme.title: Stars in Focus: Gigi Leung: Driving Miss Wealthy
programme.desc: A man is hired to look after a spoiled rich girl, but is then pulled into a scheme meant to re-evaluate her life.

programme.title: Baogu Produces
programme.desc: The long-awaited “Cold War” series returns! Director Longman Leung together with Terrance Lau and Louise Wong disclose the untold stories of filming “Cold War 1994”. While Terrance reveals filming car chase scenes had been his brush with death, Louise confesses to being stressed to play the role of a gang boss for the first time that took her three months of preparation for the action scenes. Longman also shares about the tycoon kidnapping case in the film inspired by real cases from the 1990s.....

programme.title: Galaxy Writer
programme.desc: A group of young people dreaming of becoming directors, screenwriters, actors, producers, and more. Among them were two screenwriters, Zhang Liaoyi and Sun Tan. They wrote a movie script that they believed would go down in history and were determined to bring it to the big screen.

programme.title: Table for Six
programme.desc: It is often said that food and meals bring families together, but in TABLE FOR SIX it's clear that not all family gatherings are a cause for celebration. In this melodramatic comedy, three brothers reside in a home that they inherited from their late parents. The eldest brother Steve (Dayo Wong), theoretically is the man of the house, but he constantly is getting dissed by his two younger brothers Bernard (Louis Cheung Kai Chung) and Lung (Chan Charm Man Peter) for the decisions he makes, the inedible meals that he cooks, and his complicated romantic encounters. To prepare for a family reunion dinner, Steve seeks the help of Lung's girlfriend and foodie Josephine (Ivana Wong) and in doing so, wins back their hearts for a while, until his old flame and Bernard's new girlfriend Monica (Stephy Tang) shows up. That's a recipe for a disaster waiting to explode! The unexpected visit of Steve's part-time girlfriend Meow (Lin Min-Chen) not only fails to turn down the heat and cool th.

programme.title: Goddamned Asura
programme.desc: During the night of his 18th birthday, Jan-Wen committed a random shooting homicide in the crowed night-market, with his self-made modified gun and for some mysterious reasons. The tragic incident caused the life of his family and friends, the victims, and the witnesses all facing the tremendous impact in the aftermath. However, what if there was a chance for these people to make different choices, will the tragedy remain? Will it be a brand new outcome if they all altered their behavior at the crucial moment.

programme.title: Exclusive Premiere: KOKUHO
programme.desc: In 1960s Nagasaki, after the death of his yakuza father, gifted teenager Kikuo is taken under the wing of famed Kabuki actor Hanjiro Hanai, even though the great performer already has a son, Shunsuke, who has dedicated his life to the art. Over fifty years, the relationship of the two disciples entwines and twists, and their hearts suffer as much yearning, glory and downfall as their on-stage alter-egos.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: The time has come, as it does every two years, for the senior members of Hong Kong's oldest Triad, The Wo Shing Society, to elect a new chairman. Fierce rivalries emerge between the two eligible candidates. Lok, respected by the Uncles is the favorite to win. But his rival Big D will stop at nothing to change this, including going against hundreds of years of Triad tradition and influencing the vote with money and violence.

programme.title: Election 2
programme.desc: In post-1997 Hong Kong, even the long-established “Wo Shing” Triad Society has to succumb to the upper power. The entrepreneurial sect leader Jimmy (Louis Koo) seems to be the perfect candidate to lead the Society into the new Millennium. Only problem is, Jimmy wants out..

programme.title: Still Missing
programme.desc: April is a beloved 8-year-old daughter of Pij and Ake. Unfortunately, she is kidnapped mysteriously and Pij dedicates her life to finding her missing daughter. One day there is a burnt corpse of a girl and the only thing left is a small piece of fabric that matches April's cloth on the day she disappeared. The DNA result from the fabric proves that it matches 95% of April's DNA. Pij doesn't believe that it is April's corpse and continues searching for her daughter. Pij hires Tan, who used to work for a Missing Children Foundation. Pij has hope again until they meet a psycho man who brutally kidnaps children. The life-threatening struggle to find the truth; therefore, begins..

programme.desc: Tsim Kin Yip has been an ordinary beat cop for more than two decades, failing all the promotion interviews he's tried over the years. One afternoon, Tsim is on duty in the report room. Kwan Ping Man, a suspect accused of peeping in a women's washroom, is giving a statement. Tsim heard the big secret from Kwan there's a global women's organization plotting to kill all the men in the world. Tsim finds the story ridiculous but no choice but to write down what he's told. That night, Kwan's statement has gone missing. He returns to the station to take another report, but this time Kwan has switched his story and pleads guilty. It seems he has something to hide. Tsim's suspicions are aroused and he decides to do some investigating..

programme.desc: Misol, who has a rare condition that prevents her from being exposed to sunlight, has long given up on both dreams and love. One day, she falls in love at first sight with Minjun, the 'fruit truck guy' who shows up in front of her house. To see him again, Misol eagerly counts down to sunset each day. Minjun, who's out selling fruit with determination each night, finds himself drawn to Misol, who only sings under the cover of darkness. Captivated by her Cinderella-like charm, Minjun soon begins to look forward to the night just as much. As the two grow closer, they begin to share their dreams and love... supporting one another as Misol pursues her path as a singer-songwriter, and Minjun takes on the challenge of becoming an actor..

While exchanging fire he was shot at by an AK-47 and become a sexual impotent. During the process of interviewing, Carrie has fallen to Paul. Raymond is being considered for a promotion to district court, his superiors request for him to stay away from the night-life and women. In the thick of this difficult celibate period, an 18 year old girl called Tabby barges into Raymond's life..

programme.title: The Plot
programme.desc: Young-il is a plotter who manipulates murder-for-hire cases to look like accidents. Nobody knows those accidents are in fact perfectly plotted, planned murders. Even with the higher risk of getting exposed, Young-il decides to take the case with his team members, Jackie, Wol-cheon, and Jeom-man. When the plot is ready after immaculate preparation and numerous rehearsals, the team finally makes its move, but some unexpected trouble threatens Young-il's perfect plan.

programme.title: What if SHOGUN Ieyasu Tokugawa was to become the Prime Minister
programme.desc: In the year of 2020, when Covid-19 is spreading rapidly around the world, a sudden virus outbreak in Japan leads to the death of the Prime Minister. This causes the Japanese government to put in place an unprecedented plan, which is to bring back the greatest leaders from Japanese history through AI holograms and form a super cabinet with them. These famous individuals include Tokugawa Ieyasu, Sakamoto Ryoma, Oda Nobunaga, and Toyotomi Hideyoshi. On the other hand, a TV reporter, Risa Nishimura, approaches the government spokesperson, Sakamoto Ryoma, for an exclusive scoop, in order to achieve her dream of becoming an announcer. As people start going crazy over this new legendary cabinet, Risa realizes that something is going on behind this cabinet..

programme.title: Sinkhole

Overwhelmed with happiness, he invites his colleagues to a housewarming party, but heavy overnight rain leads to a gigantic sinkhole, and in a mere minute, it swallows up the entire apartment and the people inside. Hundreds of meters down the hole, Dong-won, his neighbor Man-su (CHA Seoung-won), and the unfortunate housewarming party guests must find their way out. Rain starts to pour down, filling the sinkhole with water, giving them very little time to get back to the surface.

programme.title: Baby Blues
programme.desc: When blogger Tian Qing and song-writer Hao married, Hao buys an old house, and Tian Qing likes a doll left by the previous owner. From then on, it's as if the doll is always watching the newly weds. Soon, Tian Qing is pregnant with twins. Very unusual since neither Hao nor Tian Qing have a history of twins in their family. But a homeless man who lives at the end of their road isn't happy for them, he even warns them to move out of the house as soon as possible. It's happy news that his wife is pregnant, plus his work is going well because a popular singer wants him to produce her next track. Hao is coming home late, sometimes staying overnight in the studio. So he asks Tian Qing's younger sister, Trinket, to come stay with them to look after his wife..
