programme.title: Lady Reporter
programme.desc: FBI Cindy is ordered to Hong Kong to get the leader of counterfeit banknote manufacturing syndicate, Huang Te. In Hong Kong, Huang goes into the printing business. Ostensibly, he publishes a newspaper. But his real business is still the forgoing of banknotes. Cindy gets a job as the paper's reporter but alert Hong Kong police tell her to keep off. It is their job to get Huang. Cindy happens to know her friend's father is the prosecutor in Huang's trial. She tries to help but Huang gets off by poisoning the prosecutor. Now Cindy is desperate. The police want to see her back in America. She wants to get Huang herself..

programme.title: Swordsman
programme.desc: The Sunflower Manuscript that contains martial arts secrets is stolen from the Forbidden City. Head eunuch, Koo Kam-fook, suspects Lam Chun-nam of the theft, so he sends officer Chuen and his men to the Lam dyeing factory to investigate and kill Lam and his son, Ping-chi. Before Lam dies, he whispers to Ling Wu-chung and his schoolmate Ngok Ling-shan where he has hidden the manuscript, so that Chung can tell his son, who is not at the factory. Chung and Shan begin their trip to return to Mount Wah and meet Kwan, who is Chung's master and Shan's father. However, Chuen has already killed Chi and assumed his identity..

programme.title: Four Loves
programme.desc: The Cheng sisters, Li-fang and Li-chiung, leave war-torn Shanghai for Hong Kong. Li-chiung is rescued from robbers by Chien Pei-ling who decides to try out her luck in Hong Kong with the Chengs. They join Uncle and Aunt in Hong Kong. And they get along wonderfully with the daughter Cheng Hsiao-chuan. Li-chiung falls in love with Tony and elopes. That casts the first shadows on the friendships. It's Li-fang's turn to fall in love but both times Pei-ling steals her men. Hsiao-chuan meets Robert. A distraught Li-fang takes out a tutoring job in Macao where she falls in love. Pei-ling loves the same man..

programme.title: 92' The Legendary La Rose Noire
programme.desc: As soon as Tony Leung, starts imitating the stilted dialogue of 60s heartthrob Lui Kei, film lovers know they've entered a circle of movie-in-jokes and self-conscious world.

programme.title: The Private Eyes
programme.desc: Joseph Wong (Michael Hui), the kingpin of the Manix Private Detective Agency, a firm believer in tact and thrift. By tact, he means you can cheat all the people all the time and corners are there to be cut. By thrift, he means an underpaid staff is happy and grateful staff. By chance, he employs Lee Kwok Kit (Samuel Hui). Together, they have solved lots of wired cases. One day, while the two are investigating a blackmail case, the movie goes off and the lights come on. Scores of gun-toting hoods hold the more than 1,000 goers as hostages. On the stage Uncle Gaw (Shek Kin) threatens that it is a hold-up.

programme.title: American Grandson
programme.desc: A 60-year-old retired teacher in Shanghai promises to look after his American-born grandson who comes to visit him for a short period. They experience the clash of cultures and the inevitable generation gap when getting along..

programme.title: Casino Raider
programme.desc: Sam and Crab are a pair of skilled gamblers. When Sam chooses to leave the life, Crab engages the vengeful attention of Yakuza. The gangsters strike back by kidnapping Sam's girl..

programme.title: Fennie Yuen’s Movie Life: NIGHT LIFE HERO
programme.desc: Zhan's family was very rich, but his wife died early. He and his daughter Baby depended on each other. Zhan liked dancing in nightclub which his daughter opposed. Therefore, she dressed up to work in the nightclub in order to make her dad mad. A gangster had an interest in Baby, but fortunately Cong came forward to help. Baby and Cong developed feelings for each other. Baby used her wealth to help Cong with his career, but when Cong found out that his career was helped by Baby secretly, it was difficult for him to accept. How should Cong decide.

programme.title: Fatal Vacation
programme.desc: Travel agent Bob is very good at organizing Hong Kong tours to the Philippines. The tourists come in grooves. There are the spoiled rich girl, the ladies with loose morals, the grand parents with the child, twin brothers, the cops on holiday and the hoods on holiday: Quite a motley lot. But everything goes wrong. They are hijacked by armed Philippine bandits who hold them as hostages to bargain for the release of their captured leader. They torture and kill off the hostages daily to put pressure on the government. The tourists decide to resist..

programme.title: The Teacher Without Chalk
programme.desc: Mildly entertaining low-budget quickie that basically rips off Great Teacher Onizuka with less drama and a much less appealing lead actor. Nick Cheung is a triad who's hired by old classmate Lo May to teach a class of reprobates.

programme.title: DOCTOR NO
programme.desc: University of Hong Kong graduate Situ Luo was a young, highly skilled and promising physician. Ann, a nurse in the same hospital with him, was his girlfriend. Because of work, Luo felt that he could not take care of his girlfriend, and then proposed break up to Ann. He introduced her to her long-admired friend and colleague Xi. Unexpectedly, Xi was shot dead. Only Luo was beside him before he died, so he became the biggest suspected murderer. Because of brain stimulation and loss of memory, Luo then pleaded guilty and was sentenced to prison..

programme.title: Four Loves
programme.desc: The Cheng sisters, Li-fang and Li-chiung, leave war-torn Shanghai for Hong Kong. Li-chiung is rescued from robbers by Chien Pei-ling who decides to try out her luck in Hong Kong with the Chengs. They join Uncle and Aunt in Hong Kong. And they get along wonderfully with the daughter Cheng Hsiao-chuan. Li-chiung falls in love with Tony and elopes. That casts the first shadows on the friendships. It's Li-fang's turn to fall in love but both times Pei-ling steals her men. Hsiao-chuan meets Robert. A distraught Li-fang takes out a tutoring job in Macao where she falls in love. Pei-ling loves the same man..

programme.title: American Grandson
programme.desc: A 60-year-old retired teacher in Shanghai promises to look after his American-born grandson who comes to visit him for a short period. They experience the clash of cultures and the inevitable generation gap when getting along..

programme.title: The Diary Of A Big Man
programme.desc: In this delightful screwball comedy, Chow Yun Fat plays a stock broker who met 2 women of his dream on the same night - boutique owner Joey (Joey Wang) and air stewardess Sally (Sally Yeh). Unable to say no to either one, he ended up marrying them both, one in New York and the other in Paris. When the wives befriended each other, he solicited the help from his buddy Hung (Waise Lee) to get him out of each tight spot.

programme.title: Help!!
programme.desc: This is the first day of work for Yan at Sir Kau Kei Ho Charity Hospital's A&E. Yan is shocked to find that Jim, teaching her shedding job responsibility. An old man is taken to A&E after being struck by lightening. Each department dispatches him to one another but scrambling to take him after knowing that he is Ho Kau Kei. Ho wants to abolish the hospital's bureaucratic system, by appointing Yan, together with Joe and Jim to make changes by their own ways..

programme.title: My Family
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee loved little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Mrs. Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs. Ng at the first sight..

programme.title: Fat Choi Spirit
programme.desc: Years ago Andy's passion for Mahjong cost his family their entire fortune, his brother Louis then turned against him. Thus now Louis suffers from economy downturn..

programme.title: Mr Vampire III
programme.desc: One dark night, a charlatan Uncle Ming attempts to exorcise angry spirits in a haunted house but is unsuccessful and he narrowly escapes. He brings his two ghostly companions Ta Pao and Hsi Pao with him to a nearby town. The town is under attack by a group of bandits with supernatural powers. The thugs are led by Devil Lady, a powerful evil witch doctor. When Ming and the Paos are having dinner in a restaurant, Captain Chiang comes to harass them, and the Paos take revenge by playing tricks on Chiang. Just then, Chiang's master, Uncle Nine, appears and he subdues the two ghosts and traps them inside a wine jar. Ming pleads with Nine to release the Paos. Nine agrees to set the ghosts free but warns Ming that he must part ways with them, but Ta Pao is captured by Devil Lady later due to Chiang's act of mischief..

programme.title: Affectionately Yours
programme.desc: Aran is an honest person. He leads an ordinary life and is quite successful with his business. However, when his girlfriend leaves him, chaos begins. He feels depressed and disheartened. Aran finds his friend Ruddy for comfort. Ruddy's sister Connie has always been interested in Aran so Ruddy and his friend contrive a 'trap' for Aran. Aran is forced to marry Connie. Aran and Connie visit Japan for their honeymoon. It is where Aran learns of the scheme and meets Atsuko who really steals his heart..

programme.title: It's A Mad Mad Mad World II
programme.desc: After he lost his chance of winning easy money in the original film, Bill became an editor for a newspaper and was sent to Canada for a story. What he thought was a chance to re-launch his career turned out to be a reason to get him fired. Just when the family has settled back down in Hong Kong, Bill's wife realized she has won the lottery in Canada..

programme.title: She Shoots Straight
programme.desc: One by one, the Huangs died in the course of safeguarding law and order in Hong Kong. First, the father and then the two elder sons gave their lives in action. That leaves Tsung-pao, the youngest son, and four daughters. They are all police officers. What makes the mother prouder is Tsung-pao's marrying a senior policewoman Mina. Old Mrs. Huang is hoping to see a grandson to carry on the lawmen family tree. But the sisters don't like Mina. They make sure she does not have a good time. Mina suffers in silence. A raid on a Vietnamese gang was ordered. Tsung-pao and Mina to command. But sister Ling commits a serious mistake and the whole operation fails. Ling is suspended. She blames it on Mina..

programme.title: Superstars Comedy: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: The Buddhist Monk and the Taoist Priest, both blessed with ghost-taming powers, have been quarrelling all over the landscape. Still, they are good friends. The Priest shepherds a group of corpses home. He has to fight off some vicious devils. The Priest's classmate has been assigned the job of accompanying the coffin of a prince back to the capital. One night, a thunderbolt rips the coffin and the prince becomes a vampire. He kills many people. The Priest asks to help. He finds his classmate has killed himself..

programme.title: Fennie Yuen’s Movie Life: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Showboy may be uneducated and the son of a prostitute. But he has tact and ambition. One night he saves partisans from the ruling Manchus led by Prince Aobai..

programme.title: Royal Tramp II
programme.desc: Showboy, the good-for-nothing tramp who becomes the emperor's friend, continues his gambling, whoring ways. Little does he realize that enormous forces are aligned against him..

programme.title: The Saint of Gamblers
programme.desc: Lui puts forward a masked Saint of gamblers to cover for him in the casino. Meanwhile, Uncle Sam sets out in search of the new Saint since the real saint of gamblers retires..

programme.title: Operation Scorpio
programme.desc: Fei comes to Hong Kong with his son Yushu and winds up a back-alley barber. Yushu is now in high school but he only likes to draw pictures. He also is hot blooded, thus often getting into fights. By accident, Yushu meets beautiful Ru. He learns that Inspector Hua and underworld boss Wang are working together in prostitution and human traffic. Yushu helps Ru to escape from Wang 's catches. Fei, Yushu and Ru are being haunted by Hua's men, but are saved by self-styled kungfu master Jean-Paul. They are taken in by Master Yi and asks Yushu to prepare the beef noodles but he only wants to learn kungfu from Jean-Paul. However, Yushu realizes Master Yi actually is the kungfu master. He begs Master Yi to teach him the skills and fight against evil forces together..

programme.title: Born Wild
programme.desc: Twin brothers Tan and Tide had been fought for the best until Tan died. Tide investigates the death and meets Tan's lover Sandy. Tide finds himself being attracted to her warmth..

programme.title: Bullet In The Head
programme.desc: In 1967, Hong Kong, Ben, Paul, and Frank are childhood friends and members of a gang. They regularly brawl with members of other gangs..

programme.title: Heart to Hearts
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, just breaks up with his model girlfriend Peggy. In order to release Alex's anxiety, his friend invites him to be the part time director of a choir. Alex meets Vivian in the choir. However, Vivian's mother Chu Lai Ngo, a divorced woman who dislikes Alex at the first sight. When Alex and Chu are getting closer and closer, they imperceptibly fall in love with each other. At this moment, Peggy suddenly comes back to Alex asking for being together once again. Alex has to make his choice of love between these two women..

programme.title: Police Story II
programme.desc: Receiving a humiliating demotion to traffic duty, Chan decides to take a vacation with girlfriend May. However, when terrorists threaten Hong Kong, he abort his vacation plans..

programme.title: Fruit Punch
programme.desc: Five young men threw themselves with heart and soul into the work force. They have different approaches and different life styles. Ah Kit is the hardworking investment broker. He is so busy making money. Ah Chi is a postman believing in fung shui. Ah Hark is an apprentice in his family jewelry shop and Ah Wai failed in public exam. Ah Ming is the most unconventional of the five. Working in a Japanese restaurant. The five start a laundry shop which soon folds. Next, they try something new to save their business. Ah Ming leads a carefree life which dismays his girl, Yoko. Ah Hark's girlfriend Cat will move to Australia and leave him soon. Ah Ming and Ah Hark are going to lose their girlfriends. The five new generation are going their own ways..

programme.title: Tristar
programme.desc: Priest Hung Zhong met Bai Xuehua, a debt-ridden call girl who hid in the church‘s confession booth from the loan sharks. To help her, Zhong went in disguise to rent and live in her apartment. Zhong found new jobs for all the call girls, cultivated their interest in music and went to negotiate with the triad members who controlled them. On the other hand, CID Liu Qingfa followed Bai closely to investigate into an illicit prostitution case during which he and Zhong had many misunderstandings. In the end, will he able to solve the case? Can the girls turn over a new leaf? Zhong and Hua came to develop special feelings for each other, but as a priest, what will Zhong do.

programme.title: The Movie Star Says
programme.desc: Michael Wong rose to prominence on the big screen in the 80s with his “half Chinese, half foreign' identity and eye-catching appearance, from the early rebellious and unruly big boy to the tough and strong policeman role later. Looking back the bygone days, he barely knew Cantonese but was fortunate to meet a like-minded partner who helped him through the break-in period, and which film from his decades-long career impressed him the most? After played countless roles, how does he feel about his identity as an actor.

programme.title: Aces Go Places III
programme.desc: King Kong is commissioned by a man who claims to be Mr. Bond, special agent from the British Secret Service to recover for the Queen precious stones stolen from her crown which are now in Hong Kong. Back in Hong Kong, a Secret Service man from the Bond Street Headquarters, Mr. Tom Collins, has just arrived to find out a gang of notorious international crooks led by Mr. Bond. Carried out his mission successfully for Mr. Bond, King Kong is summoned by the Governor to assist Collins in retrieving the stolen goods and catch Mr. Bond's gang.

programme.title: Aces Go Places IV
programme.desc: The invention of a prism - a special brain stimulant, gets King Kong and Inspector into a series of dangerous adventures. The lives of Inspector Ho and her son, Baldy Junior are also threatened by the villains..

programme.title: Doctor Mack
programme.desc: Dr. Mack Lau gives up his career in a famed hospital and opens a clinic in a run-down place. Not only does he heal the residences' wounds, but also their torn-and-broken hearts.

programme.title: Superstars Sunday: By Hook Or By Crook
programme.desc: Flower Kid was a Robinhood type hero who robbed the rich and gave to the poor. He was adored by many people, especially a kid named Fatso. Lady Chin, a woman of guts and evil, hated Flower Kid because he once refused her offer of killing her own husband. She then married a rich big shot and used his money and power to hire a bounty hunter called Skinny. Skinny caught Fatso, who had been imitating Flower Kid. They fought, understood each other, became good friends and set out to find the real Flower Kid. Eventually, they found Flower Kid in the ghetto, an old man no longer a handsome Kid, but a Flower Man. Skinny and Fatso sympathized with him..

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: Set in the 1940s. Song Dan Ping, an ambitious theatre actor, falls deeply in love beautiful To Wan-Yin. However, To's father does not allow and betroth her to a rich man..

programme.title: The Untold Story
programme.desc: In August 1985, a mutilated corpse is found on the beach of Macao. A police investigation uncovers the mysterious disappearance of the entire family of the Eight Immortals Restaurant. Based on a shocking and horrifying true story.

programme.title: Warm on a Cold Night
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事.

programme.title: Adrift In Love
programme.desc: 侯文詠原著小說改編，兩段糾結的情感，交織出一場關於「選擇」的情愛旅程.

programme.title: The Heart 2
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”.

programme.title: Eight Hundred
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗.

programme.title: Lady Revenger Returns from the Fire
programme.desc: 溫婉恬靜的羅家大小姐羅愛蓮，因突如其來的災難，一夜間失去了一切，從人間富貴花被打入泥潭。經歷重重困境，最終經歷過九死一生的羅愛蓮鳳凰涅槃成為能文能武的鏢局大小姐沈丹青（徐璐飾），從此浴火重生，踏上手撕仇人的荊棘之路，開啟了她的別樣人生。沈丹青在復仇的過程中意外闖入了尋找丟失寶藏的徐將軍（魏哲鳴飾）視野，引起他的懷疑，這使沈丹青的這條復仇之路更加跌宕起伏、與眾不同，兩人在一次次驚心動魄的鬥智中，相互成全，惺惺相惜，發生了一系列扣人心弦的故事.

programme.title: Lady Revenger Returns from the Fire
programme.desc: 溫婉恬靜的羅家大小姐羅愛蓮，因突如其來的災難，一夜間失去了一切，從人間富貴花被打入泥潭。經歷重重困境，最終經歷過九死一生的羅愛蓮鳳凰涅槃成為能文能武的鏢局大小姐沈丹青（徐璐飾），從此浴火重生，踏上手撕仇人的荊棘之路，開啟了她的別樣人生。沈丹青在復仇的過程中意外闖入了尋找丟失寶藏的徐將軍（魏哲鳴飾）視野，引起他的懷疑，這使沈丹青的這條復仇之路更加跌宕起伏、與眾不同，兩人在一次次驚心動魄的鬥智中，相互成全，惺惺相惜，發生了一系列扣人心弦的故事.

Aces vs Aces Season 8
programme.desc: 每期圍繞一個主題，邀請兩支王牌團隊，兩位隊長各帶領嘉賓進行對戰，通過才藝比拼、遊戲競技，決出王牌中的王牌；「王牌家族」沈騰、華晨宇、關曉彤、宋亞軒、沈濤已就位，歡樂派對即將開場，還有「王牌好友」楊迪、沙溢、唐嫣驚喜赴約，一起點燃快樂.

programme.title: Rap Star Dream Maker
programme.desc: 由周杰倫擔當音樂造夢者，召集夢想生活官劉畊宏和夢想見證官王鶴棣，及四組廠牌經理人GAI周延&布瑞吉Bridge、歐陽靖&小鬼王琳凱、艾熱&早安、VaVa&盛宇，一同為說唱新生代們的追夢之旅保駕護航；打破傳統導師帶隊模式，通過構建真實師徒關系，共同打造獨具特色的說唱廠牌；透過競演激發說唱歌手創作才華，在全民中尋找下一個說唱巨星.

programme.title: Love Never Comes Late Season 4
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: She Is the Phoenix
programme.desc: 圍繞雙重生的復仇主線展開，女主角姜樂瑤慘死後重生，發現閨蜜蓉兒頂替了自己的身份嫁入寧府，前一世她被嫁給痴傻少爺，更發現父母並非死於意外而是被人所害；這一世，她與同樣重生的伙伴聯手，直面寧府權貴的迫害，在身份置換與權謀博弈中揭露真相，為自己討回公道.

programme.title: Flying Up Without Disturb
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師.

programme.title: United Across the Seas
programme.desc: 追溯孫中山領導的民主革命從夏威夷開始的歷程，體現孫中山先生「華僑是革命之母」的著名論斷，真實呈現一百多年前跌宕起伏的辛亥風雲，展現海外華僑華人先輩在異鄉奮斗的艱辛及無私熱愛之情.

programme.title: Masterpiece in Jiangnan Season 3
programme.desc: 聚焦中國優秀文化傳統，講述文化名家和文藝人才的故事及師徒傳習技藝的過程，記錄與展現“名師帶徒”計畫創作成果.

programme.title: Perfect Match Season 16
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: Ready To Dance Season 2
programme.desc: 第2季邀請了來自粵港澳地區的街舞少年團參加，並由贊多、敖子逸、王晨藝、黃譽博等擔任街舞領軍人物，少年們在他們的帶領下，分別進行初舞台、合作舞台以及最終的留名舞台三個階段的挑戰，通過動感的音樂和充滿激情的舞蹈，將中國傳統文化特色與街舞文化相結合.

programme.title: Crush of Music Season 3
programme.desc: 延續歌手與原創音樂人「雙向奔赴」的核心模式，通過歌曲爭奪與舞台首演挖掘華語樂壇新生力量；嘉賓包括容祖兒、周深、劉宇寧、黃子弘凡、希林娜依·高、于文文等；以「緣」為紐帶，讓實力唱將與原創作品相遇，打造兼具競技懸念與音樂品質的視聽盛宴.

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力.

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力.

programme.title: Two Stars, One Boss
programme.desc: 兩位50+娛樂圈前輩胡軍、李乃文化身為經理人團隊，為具有代表性的年輕後輩藝人擔任經理人，全面負責藝人的行程安排，從接送機、行程對接、妝髮準備到工作陪伴、突發危機處理...等；他們需要動用自己的人生智慧和圈內經驗，為藝人保駕護航.

programme.title: Live and Love Season 2
programme.desc: 以「尋找勢均力敵的參與者」為核心模式，通過團隊協作任務獲取生存物資，個人競技爭奪約會權，並設置淘汰機制與心動投票綁定規則；素人嘉賓們將逃離都市，直面愛情與生存的挑戰，在人群中尋找勢均力敵的彼此.

programme.title: Fantastic Journey Season 2
programme.desc: 孟非、劉震雲決心效仿中國最早的自由行「西遊」，攜何廣智、李雅娟升級為「非震式旅行社」；邀請尹正、哈妮克孜、武藝、張雨綺、楊迪、楊超越等飛行嘉賓，先後到達喀什，塔什庫爾干，獨庫公路，烏茲別克斯坦等地，串聯起雪山草原、戈壁大漠、城市綠洲，開啟一場前所未有的奇遇之旅.

programme.title: Melody Journey

programme.title: Sing! Asia
programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演.

programme.desc: 明星戶外旅居真人秀，由沈騰攜手「出發家族」白敬亭、賈冰、金晨、宋亞軒、胡先煦和王安宇等新老朋友開啟歡樂野遊之旅，體會當地人的日常生活，感受各地自然山水的風景名畫，治愈當下的焦慮，感受到大自然及好朋友在一起的快樂.

programme.title: Traditional Chinese Medicine Youth Chronicles Season 3
programme.desc: 由陳妍希、夏之光、高卿塵、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，帶著對中醫文化的虔誠與需求，踏上制定的研學體驗地圖，遇見不同行醫風格的中醫師，與他們同吃同住，同苦同樂，深度體驗中醫藥從業者的工作艱辛，學習簡易上手的健康養生功法，從中體驗和領悟中醫藥的博大精深.

programme.title: Talk With Famous Doctors
programme.desc: 全新研發的大型互動健康科普節目；從「重治療」到「重預防」，加大醫療健康知識的深度普及，把權威的資訊送到身邊.

programme.title: Who's Still Standing Youth Edition Season 2
programme.desc: 張泉靈、黃聖依等擔任少年見證官，在賽制內容上進行升級，分為搶位賽、團隊輪答賽、項目挑戰賽三個環節，圍繞真實生活場景與綜合性課題，著重考驗自主探究與協作破題的綜合能力；題庫覆蓋校內學科、傳統文化、時事邏輯等多領域，讓少年們在解題中感受思考的樂趣，在挑戰中養成自主探究的習慣.

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力.

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力.

programme.title: Her Prime Season 2
programme.desc: 以「姐姐當家，愛是什麼」為主題，集結杜華、房主任、冉瑩穎、小鹿、徐夢桃五位當家姐姐，以更加豐富的人生樣本回應當代女性共同面對的生活課題；觀察團成員李維嘉、倪萍、倪子君、張泉靈回歸，共同組成多元觀察體系，從專業視角與大眾視角出發，共同尋找愛是什麼的答案.

programme.title: Ready To Dance Season 2
programme.desc: 第2季邀請了來自粵港澳地區的街舞少年團參加，並由贊多、敖子逸、王晨藝、黃譽博等擔任街舞領軍人物，少年們在他們的帶領下，分別進行初舞台、合作舞台以及最終的留名舞台三個階段的挑戰，通過動感的音樂和充滿激情的舞蹈，將中國傳統文化特色與街舞文化相結合.

programme.title: Perfect Match Season 16
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情.

programme.title: Love Never Comes Late Season 4
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚.

programme.title: Hit 2026 X Stage
programme.desc: 延續無修音、無剪輯、無劇本的核心底色，助力好歌破圈，並在內容編排、歌曲推薦體系等方面進行煥新升級；邀請了胡夏、姚曉棠、姚弛、王櫟鑫、小鬼-王琳凱、付辛博、劉端端、吉克雋逸...等超強陣容，打造一場全天候的真音樂狂歡派對.

programme.title: Talk With Famous Doctors
programme.desc: 全新研發的大型互動健康科普節目；從「重治療」到「重預防」，加大醫療健康知識的深度普及，把權威的資訊送到身邊.

programme.title: Talk To Your Boss: Friends Season
programme.desc: 節目全新升級，以「老友季」作為主題，把觀察樣本聚焦在情感更濃、羈絆更深的職場戰友身上，對職場上下級關系的維度進行了深度開拓；通過職場老友這一切面，去探討職場中更復雜的問題解法.

programme.title: Masterpiece in Jiangnan Season 3
programme.desc: 聚焦中國優秀文化傳統，講述文化名家和文藝人才的故事及師徒傳習技藝的過程，記錄與展現“名師帶徒”計畫創作成果.

programme.title: Perfect Match
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》全新改版，24位女嘉賓分為心動區和觀察區，男嘉賓暫不亮相，在「第二現場」與女嘉賓隔空對話。男女嘉賓通過雙向選擇，決定兩人能否成功牽手.

programme.title: The Force of Nature 2022
programme.desc: Climate change is our defining crisis, and it is happening even faster than we thought. But we're not powerless to stop it. The impacts of climate change are felt in every corner of the world. Increased temperatures are causing environmental disasters. The sea levels are rising, the Arctic is melting, coral reefs are dying, oceans are acidifying, and forests are burning. It is clear that business as usual is not an option. With climate change reaching irreversible heights, now is the time for bold collective action. The climate emergency is a race we are losing, but it is a race we can win.

programme.title: David Attenborough A Life on Earth
programme.desc: The incredible journey and illustrious career of one of the most travelled men in history, this documentary tells the story of how Sir David Attenborough came to be the voice of modern natural history programs by bringing the natural world into our homes.

programme.title: Billy Goes North
programme.desc: Billy throws down in a no-holds-barred cage match with one of the North's most feared predators, then teams up with trapper Ben for a dawn-to-dusk eviction of raccoons from clients' homes.

programme.title: Billy Goes North
programme.desc: Billy comes to the rescue at a farm where a predator is creating a horror show at a chicken coop. Then he goes way north to work with partner Terry to solve a beaver problem.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport
programme.desc: After capturing and loading 30 African Elephants into their transport crates, the convoy is finally ready for the long journey ahead. It’s a 50-hour non-stop drive from South Africa to Mozambique. The team must arrive at Zinave National Park before sunset on day 2 to safely offload the elephants. However, a late departure and unexpected delays at the borders means they could be facing offloading the elephants under only the light of the moon. Not ideal for the exhausted drivers and the wild elephants who are ready to get out of their transportation crates and explore their new home.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport
programme.desc: A variety of Australian horses are purchased from Singapore investors and annually a cargo plane with up to 50 horses are flown from Sydney Airport to Manilla Airport. The horses range from race horses to miniature ponies to Clydesdales. A mission like this takes meticulous planning. Cameron from Equine International Airfreight won’t let one piece of incorrect paperwork stall his mission. Each horse has its own documentation, if one paper is scrutinised by customs it will mean game over for the mission. Even the custom designed horse crates are scrutinised by officials. The final veterinary checks are undertaken by a government vet at quarantine and the horses are washed prior to the trip. The first leg of the journey is a one-hour drive on a convoy of four semi-trailers moving from quarantine to the airport. But no matter how careful Cameron has been with his planning, there are things beyond his control. A late truck driver means hitting Sydney peak hour traffic. The plane transporti.

programme.title: Darwaza Bandh Rakho
programme.desc: Four men form a gang planning a quick ransom from a rich girl, but the scheme backfires, testing loyalties and forcing unexpected, life changing choices. Release Year: 2006 Director: J. D. Chakravarthi.

programme.title: Kabhi Kabhie

Things take a turn when they meet again after many years. Release Year: 1976 Director: Yash Chopra Awards: Best Music Director: Khayyam, Best Lyricist: Sahir Ludhianvi, Best Playback Singer - Male: Mukesh, Best Screenplay: Sagar Sarhadi Filmfare Awards.

programme.title: The Great Indian Family
programme.desc: Ved Vyas Tripathi, aka Bhajan Kumar, is a devout Hindu man who faces an identity crisis and a personal dilemma when he discovers he is actually a Muslim by birth. Release Year: 2023 Director: Vijay Krishna Acharya.

programme.title: Hadh Kar Di Aapne
programme.desc: Raj's obsession with winning gets in the way of his love life, but through determination and hard work, he chases his dreams and ultimately finds success. Release Year: 2000 Director: Manoj Agrawal.

programme.title: Sunny Sanskari Ki Tulsi Kumari
programme.desc: After their partners, Ananya and Vikram, heartlessly dump them to marry each other, Sunny and Tulsi form an unlikely alliance. Together, they plot to gatecrash their exes' big wedding. Release Year: 2025 Director: Shashank Khaitan Awards: 2025 Winner NDTV Indian of the Year - ActreSS of The Year - Janhvi Kapoor, 2025 Winner Special Award - Supporting Actor of the Year - Maniesh Paul.

programme.title: Blast Zone
programme.desc: A martial-arts-trained headmaster and his close family find their peaceful lives shattered when they unexpectedly tangle with a ruthless mercenary gang guarding a stash of stolen cash.

programme.title: Stree
programme.desc: A town is held in the grip of terror by tales of a mysterious woman who calls men by their name and then abducts them, leaving their clothes behind. Release Year: 2018 Director: Amar Kaushik Awards: 2019 Winner Screen Award - Best Film, 2019 Nominee Popular Award -Best Film, 2019 Winner Bollywood BusineSS Award - The 100 Crore Club, 2019 Nominee Main Award - Best Film.

programme.title: Shabri
programme.desc: Shabri kills a cop who tortures her brother and tries to rape her. But when her brother is killed, she decides to avenge his death. Release Year: 2011 Director: Lalit Marathe.

programme.title: Vikram: Hitlist
programme.desc: A special agent investigates a murder committed by a masked group of serial killers. However, a tangled maze of clues soon leads him to the drug kingpin of Chennai.

programme.title: Saptagiri Express
programme.desc: Saptagiri, a happy-go-lucky actor, is forced to do his late father's job after his demise. However, he soon learns that his father was actually murdered and embarks on a quest for vengeance.

programme.title: Monsoon Shootout
programme.desc: Adi, a policeman, joins an anti-extortion unit of the Mumbai Police led by Khan. When an ambush goes wrong, Adi chases a wanted gangster, Shiva. Release Year: 2013 Director: Amit Kumar.

programme.title: Namak Halaal
programme.desc: Arjun, a village bumpkin working in a city hotel, learns of a threat to his boss Raja's life and must save him. Release Year: 1982 Director: Prakash Mehra Awards: Filmfare Awards : Best Playback Singer - Male: Kishore Kumar.

programme.title: Veer-Zaara
programme.desc: The story of Squadron Leader Veer Pratap Singh and Zaara Haayat Khan, of Lahore, during conflict between India and Pakistan. Release Year: 2004 Director: Yash Chopra Awards: IIFA: Multiple wins Music, Story, Lyrics, Female SingerZee Cine Awards and Stardust: Wins in music/performance categoriesNational Film Awards, 47th Filmfare Awards.

programme.title: Chhichhore
programme.desc: Divided by time, united by a tragic incident. In a bittersweet reunion, seven middle-aged friends take a walk down the memory lane at the least expected place. Release Year: 2019 Director: Nitesh Tiwari Awards: 2020 Nominee Screen Award - Best Film Critics, 2020 Nominee Filmfare Award -Best Film, 2019 Winner Nickelodeon Kids' Choice Award - Favorite Movie, 2020 Winner Regional Award - Best Feature Film in Hindi, 2020 Nominee Popular Award - Best Story.

programme.title: Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani
programme.desc: Dhanlaxmi belittles her disabled husband, Kanwal. His mention of 'Jamini' leads them to Rani. Rocky and Rani fall in love but face family conflicts. Release Year: 2023 Director: Karan Johar Awards: 69th Filmfare Awards, IIFA Awards 2024, Zee Cine and Other Popular Awards.

programme.title: Garam Masala
programme.desc: Watch the hilarious outcome as two casanova photographers try to out-do each other in their personal and professional lives. Release Year: 2005 Director: Priyadarshan Awards: 2006 Winner Filmfare Award- Best Comic Actor- Akshay Kumar.

programme.title: Fighter
programme.desc: A reckless yet brilliant squadron leader and his team of elite fighter pilots face mortal dangers and inner demons as they unite for a deadly mission. Release Year: 2024 Director: Siddharth Anand Awards: 2024 WinnerIconic Award- Best Supporting ActreSS Sanjeeda Sheikh, 2024 WinnerIconic Award- Actor of the Year Karan Singh Grover.

programme.title: Kya Love Story Hai
programme.desc: A carefree youth finds love at first sight, though he has to work to get the object of his affection to notice him. Release Year: 2007 Director: Lovely Singh.

programme.title: Apurva
programme.desc: In a thrilling twist, Apurva, a clever and brave woman, outsmarts the notorious Chambal gang, proving that intelligence and wit can triumph over even the most feared criminals. Release Year: 2023 Director: Nikhil Nagesh Bhat Awards: 4 nominations.

programme.title: Ghar
programme.desc: Vikas regains his senses and finds himself in hospital with a head wound with Aarti too in the same hospital after being assaulted. Release Year: 1978 Director: Manik Chatterjee.

programme.title: The Great Samshuddin Family
programme.desc: An eccentric family navigates hilarious daily mishaps, domestic squabbles, and heartwarming moments, constantly finding funny ways to stay united despite their endless personal differences. Release Year: 2025 Director: Anusha Rizvi.

programme.title: Raghuveer

programme.title: Nikaah

Chopra Awards: 1983 WinnerFilmfare Award- Best Playback Singer Female- Salma Agha.

programme.title: The Iron Heart
programme.desc: The Iron Heart follows Apollo Adelantar, an undercover operative with a traumatic past who is assigned to infiltrate a powerful crime syndicate. As he goes deeper into his dangerous mission, Apollo is forced to confront painful truths about his identity, loyalty, and family-especially when trusted allies turn into enemies. Fueled by vengeance, justice, and his desire to protect the innocent, Apollo and his companions face relentless trials that test not only their strength but also their moral convictions.

programme.title: La Vida Lena
programme.desc: La Vida Lena is a revenge drama about Magda, a talented young woman who is bullied because of a facial scar. After creating a successful beauty soap formula, she becomes the target of the powerful Narciso family. Betrayed and stripped of everything she loves, she returns with a new identity and appearance, determined to exact revenge on those who destroyed her life.

美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 美食KOL Arthur帶暉哥品嚐韓國「邪惡美食」。薄切牛三角刺身油脂豐腴，入口即融；醬油生醃斑馬瀨尿蝦鮮味濃郁，蝦膏甘香；牛腸鍋包含不同內臟部位，「脂味」十足；炸雞配大閘蟹粉，鮮味大增。位於荔枝角的西班牙餐廳主打該國各地特色佳餚。招牌生烤乳豬皮脆肉嫩，薯仔飽吸肉汁精華；以本地小銀魚、鮮魷及九肚魚炮製的脆炸小食極惹味；紅蝦海鮮飯集海鮮精華於一身；馬德里傳統夾肉包配烤和牛、焦糖洋蔥等配料，層次豐富。.

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻 :最強生命線[粵] 及 好嘢港多啲[粵]
programme.desc: 睡食症是一種發生在睡眠期間的異常行為，病人會在半夢半醒、無意識的狀態下進食，甚至吃下生肉等食物，醒來後往往對過程毫無記憶。此症常見由傳統安眠藥引起，因此對於長期或大量服用安眠藥的病人、長者及曾有病史的人士而言，有睡食症的機率會相對較高。患者亦會因常在夜間無意識進食、煮食而引致危險及導致體重上升。.

那年花開月正圓#25[粵/普]
programme.desc: 周瑩(孫儷 飾)意外嫁入陝西吳氏家族，新婚不久丈夫猝然離世，她陷入各種利益博弈和紛爭，但她以特有的聰慧，睿智與堅忍，在錯綜複雜的情感糾葛與家族矛盾中，用自己的方式擔起吳家大業，成就了晚清女商聖的傳奇。.

programme.desc: 周瑩(孫儷 飾)意外嫁入陝西吳氏家族，新婚不久丈夫猝然離世，她陷入各種利益博弈和紛爭，但她以特有的聰慧，睿智與堅忍，在錯綜複雜的情感糾葛與家族矛盾中，用自己的方式擔起吳家大業，成就了晚清女商聖的傳奇。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 美食KOL Arthur帶暉哥品嚐韓國「邪惡美食」。薄切牛三角刺身油脂豐腴，入口即融；醬油生醃斑馬瀨尿蝦鮮味濃郁，蝦膏甘香；牛腸鍋包含不同內臟部位，「脂味」十足；炸雞配大閘蟹粉，鮮味大增。位於荔枝角的西班牙餐廳主打該國各地特色佳餚。招牌生烤乳豬皮脆肉嫩，薯仔飽吸肉汁精華；以本地小銀魚、鮮魷及九肚魚炮製的脆炸小食極惹味；紅蝦海鮮飯集海鮮精華於一身；馬德里傳統夾肉包配烤和牛、焦糖洋蔥等配料，層次豐富。.

programme.title: 按居按揭轉介呈獻:星二代煮飯仔[粵]
programme.desc: 黃長興偕女兒晞桐亮相《星二代煮飯仔》，爸爸事前評估女兒廚藝僅得二星。晞桐反駁值五星，怎料買菜時竟把芋頭錯認成蒜頭，情況令人擔憂。晞桐挑戰要蒸、炸、焗三重工序的法式雞卷，長興愛女心切在場外頻頻提點。晞桐卻心態輕鬆，更忍不住邊下廚邊偷吃。隨後父女聯手烹調另一道菜，長興被取笑不肯放手讓女兒嘗試。父女問答考驗，長興全猜錯女兒心思。壓軸題，晞桐如帶男朋友回家吃飯，長興會有甚麼反應？晞桐竟認為爸爸會下逐客令！.

programme.title: 娛樂新聞報道[粵] 及 警聲百二秒 IV[粵]
programme.desc: 每晚緊貼香港娛樂圈的消息，以至世界各地的影視娛樂新聞，報道藝人最新動態、劇集和電影宣傳、演唱會精華、頒獎禮盛況等，甚至遠赴外地採訪娛樂盛事、追蹤各地影星，專訪觀眾熟悉的歌、影、視紅人，讓大家瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈的動態和最新消息。.

programme.title: 紅色高踭鞋#41[粵/韓][PG]
programme.desc: 熙瓊請孫議員幫忙使LORA獲獎，赫相非但不領情，更警告她不要搞小動作。珍瑪一心想要殺掉赫相，而吳Sir更告知調查無法有任何進展，於是在赫相與淑子兩家人愉快用餐時，珍瑪死瞪著赫相，臉上表情變得越來越駭人。.

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場[粵]
設計型空間[粵]
programme.desc: 全開放式蝸居採用Timeless設計慨念，給人劃時代感覺，當中一道可移動電視牆，怎樣為簡約蝸居解決收納問題？嘉賓衛志豪注重整齊潔淨，對收納家中雜物又有何良策？.

programme.title: 就是愛美麗[粵/普]
programme.desc: 想有彈潤光澤肌，除了要認真保濕，還要懂得運用植物油護膚，保養教官袁觀玲教授正確的油保養。原宿是日本年輕人的潮流指標地，一間由日本國民文具品牌打造的精品店，不但出售各種特色文具和工具，還有咖啡和輕食供應。「MIT時尚」介紹以純手工製作鞋款的品牌，客人可自選布料及鞋底，擁有一雙獨一無二的鞋。「愛美麗盲測」測試四款人氣化妝掃的觸感、延展性及遮瑕度；「愛美麗時尚」探訪台灣東區小巷一間充滿個性及率性的店舖。.

programme.title: 就是愛美麗[粵/普]
programme.desc: 時尚無極限，聯名才是王道！陳艾熙、Dora、關婷玉分享時尚聯名單品和彩妝。2018年10月，原宿出現一間複合式潮流精品店，囊括了五個不同風格的潮流品牌，「東京時尚遊」帶大家閒逛這間日本新潮流指標的選品店。「愛美麗時尚」走訪台灣富錦街一間複合式設計精品選品店，集合各地的皮革單品，而兩名台灣女設計師打造的金工品牌單品同樣值得入手。「網絡紅什麼」教授自製天氣瓶，方便觀測氣象，決定每天出門的穿搭。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 大廚陳國強帶暉哥到憑珍珠奶茶打響名堂的台灣過江龍餐廳，品嚐台式美食。「人氣」鐵觀音珍珠奶茶層次豐富，珍珠煙韌Ｑ彈；紅燒牛肉麵湯底濃郁，牛肉及牛筋燉煮入味；蝦子蔥油乾拌麵鹹鮮惹味；慢煮豬手滿載膠質精華。黃嘉雯駕車載廖慧儀到東涌海傍的墨西哥餐廳，一邊欣賞飛機升降景致，一邊品嚐佳餚，包括原條燒粟米、慢煮手撕牛肉配香菜飯、墨式香烤雞粟米餅、鐵板烤豬肉配軟粟米餅，以及墨西哥風味朱古力蛋糕，盡享美景與美食。.

programme.title: 旅人視角[粵/普]
programme.desc: 回到台北，祐宏從歷史古蹟建成圓環出發。先訪台灣碩果僅存的繁體鑄字行，大家可製作專屬印章。以豆漿作湯底的湯麵，鮮味十足；店內亦供應東北口味的麵食。獲不少網紅推介的「打卡」甜品店，內裡還有一款深受女生喜愛的特飲，有何魅力？祐宏「模仿」文青走進鋼筆專門店，除了可找到各式風格的鋼筆之外，更可嘗試為鋼筆添加墨水。「偽文青」佑宏還要DIY自成一派的筆記簿，想不到紙張的顏色，厚薄度、質料等亦有甚多選擇。.

programme.title: 網紅甜卡[粵]
programme.desc: Christy、Jessica踏上「整餅」之路，Veronica先替二人裝身，衣著與往訪餐廳主色調「襯到絕」！二人先到藍帶畢業生創辦的甜品店，學造「無花果黑芝麻杏仁撻」；並品嚐外脆內軟的法式甜點「可麗露」。甜品上完美擠花竟得力於黑膠唱片機？兩位主持接著拜訪前五星級酒店甜品師，實習炮製「法式曲奇」，竟然好吃懶做？招牌甜點「雲呢拿撻」的撻皮，講求「快」工出細貨；標準厚度只有3mm，口感百分百香脆！.

programme.title: 那年花開月正圓#27[粵/普]
programme.desc: 周瑩(孫儷 飾)意外嫁入陝西吳氏家族，新婚不久丈夫猝然離世，她陷入各種利益博弈和紛爭，但她以特有的聰慧，睿智與堅忍，在錯綜複雜的情感糾葛與家族矛盾中，用自己的方式擔起吳家大業，成就了晚清女商聖的傳奇。.

programme.title: 富途證券特約:富途講美股[粵]
programme.desc: 與富途證券聯手製作的五分鐘美股專題節目，每個美股交易日開市前由專家剖析當天大市動態和走勢，幫助投資者捉緊當前投資機會。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 居港越南人Tracy帶伍倩彤品嚐越南地道檬粉。米紙蝦卷包裹檬粉、香菜等配料，加上秘製花生醬，酸爽開胃；蟹膏番茄湯檬鮮味濃郁，蟹膏蛋餅飽吸湯汁精華。此外，順化牛腱米線湯底鮮甜；斑蘭綠豆糕層次分明，同樣不容錯過。黃嘉雯駕車載胡美貽到荃灣的酒店品嚐豐盛美饌。香烤拼盤包羅羊架、串燒及迷你漢堡包等惹味佳餚；特色下午茶套餐則有鴨肝西多士、芒果拿破崙等鹹甜美點，以及由區內老字號食店供應的馳名糯米糍，滋味十足。.

programme.title: 下飯江湖4 食色福州[粵/普]
programme.desc: 印尼華僑周美花經營的牛肉粉店，而吃牛肉粉一定不能缺少特製的辣椒醬；華僑後代黃陽鴻在中國開設餐廳，用一碗碗醬料令客人領略印尼的獨特風味；土耳其人阿拉丁在福州開設餐廳，餐廳更成為在閩土耳其人的第二個家。.

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45周年真盤源特約 :樓計專家[粵]
programme.desc: 元朗二手成交由高位回落三成，擴闊議價空間，區內較早發展的屋苑，樓價處於甚麼水平？西沙一個大型新盤，有新期數入伙，其中一個高層三房戶，附設儲物室，交樓質素能否保持？.

programme.title: 東方表行 Take Your Time 呈獻:我和牠的故事[粵]
programme.desc: 樊亦敏一直也愛回家，皆因家中有三隻可愛狗狗，當中Hana和Kuma可謂「松鼠狗姐弟」，時常朝着同一方向。至於臘腸犬Fred被原主人形容「難搞」，亦敏特意由英國越洋接牠回港，望以「愛」感化。其實亦敏也有養兔，兔仔是《開心速遞》的「演員」之一，卻發覺公司環境並不適合牠，遂帶返家飼養。亦敏清楚兔仔所需，也許跟留學時一段錯失經歷有關？暫託爸媽俊其、泳芍於貓貓入屋48小時內的黃金時間，如何為牠們建立安全感？.

programme.title: 點劇成真:降魔的#19[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 晶晶出院後回家，發現神石失蹤，原來馬季事先將神石收好，免得敢當被魔徹底消滅。馬季為了報仇，要求敢當教他降魔，但馬季心浮氣躁，訓練難以見效，貝娜於是帶他前往精靈出現的森林。芷若回家後，看見剛出獄的展明早已坐着等候她。展明欲佔有芷若不果，於是打算掐死她；芷若以馬季所贈的特製項鏈搫退展明，可是逃到樓下時，卻遇上兩名男子逼近。馬季收到芷若被擄的影像，跟從展明的指示前往營救，沒想到原來受害者並非芷若…….

programme.title: OT無限loop
programme.desc: 每晚深夜，公司仲有邊個未收工？有屋企唔返，咁搏命係愛定係責任？閉路電視全程無間斷直擊，《社畜求生101》主角阿星同阿花捱更抵夜職場血淚史！.

programme.title: 兄弟幫[粵]
programme.desc: 餐桌禮儀不單顯示個人修養，也是尊重別國飲食文化的行為。禮儀學校創辦人梁迦傑指西方餐桌禮儀中，餐具擺放十分重要，餐桌桌布更是食客的「第二張面孔」，到底有何學問？麵包碟、主菜碟、水杯應擺放在餐桌特定位置，就連吃麵包也有既定步驟。用餐時亦要避免製造不必要的噪音，拿刀切食物更有正確手勢。喝酒方面，除了需懂得怎樣拿起杯子，還要保持優雅，避免動作過大。日本菜餐桌禮儀則着重「活、鮮、欣賞」，又有甚麼注意事項？.

programme.title: 兄弟幫[粵]
programme.desc: 禮儀學校創辦人梁迦傑，今集繼續細說餐桌禮儀的知識。港人北上內地談生意，總要出席不少中餐飯局，但南方、北方飯局的餐桌禮儀有何分別？如餐桌上擺放了兩對筷子，哪一邊是公筷？而筷子長度亦有要求，切忌一長一短！餐巾用法也有學問，大家應將餐巾摺起放在大腿上，還是放在碟下？餐桌之外，身體語言亦需注意基本禮儀。要表現出自然又自信，站立時除了挺胸收腹，雙手又應如何擺放？鞠躬時的角度、四種握手方式，更有不同的意義。.

programme.title: 旅人視角[粵/普]
programme.desc: 來到台南市臨海的安平區，當然不可錯過水上活動。宏佑試玩滑浪風帆，挑戰後卻留下遺憾？台南四季如夏，有甜品店以當地的時令水果製作冰棒、特飲等，相當消暑。店內的招牌芒果刨冰更是「打卡」熱選，可營造出「仙氣」效果！虱目魚是台灣人眼中的瑰寶，還衍生出體驗館。內裡除了可吃到「虱目魚蛋捲」之外，更有用虱目魚製成的美容產品。宏佑DIY手拉杯陶藝、劍獅彩繪，體驗安平的文藝；還會乘船暢遊安平運河，欣賞兩旁風景名勝。.

programme.title: 網紅甜卡[粵]
programme.desc: Christy、Jessica進行街訪，探討巴黎人的早餐文化，接著往麵包店選購特色麵包及甜品，與Veronica在巴黎鐵塔下的戰神廣場野餐、打卡。Veronica預備的貝雷帽份外搶鏡，配戴時有甚麼需注意？她還分享打卡技巧。三人更拆解迷思，嘗試法國風味把牛角包浸泡咖啡來吃，會否中伏？兩位主持造訪巴黎最古老的糕點店及其姊妹朱古力店，試吃鎮店甜品「Rum baba」、朱古力放題……美食背後有甚麼故事？.

programme.title: 女生素舍[粵]
programme.desc: 人們對芫茜總是「愛恨分明」！「勁愛」芫茜的素食專家Pamela與拍檔Gillian和Michelle來個「芫茜兩吃」，「芫茜控」切勿錯過！第一道菜式「芫茜餅」，材料就只有麵粉、水及主角芫茜。香脆煎餅內有「爆餡」的芫茜碎，不喜歡芫茜的Gillian試食後會否對芫茜改觀？另一道菜式「芫茜青醬薯仔麵疙瘩」，Pam如何調製味道極富層次的秘製青醬？口感軟綿綿的薯仔麵疙瘩又怎樣製作？且看Pam的巧手示範。.

programme.title: 關注關注組[粵]
programme.desc: 不少人注重飲用水的品質，安裝濾水器、電解水機各有支持者，美貽卻稱外國人覺得飲水應「純天然」才是正道？「日行」這次盲測六款市售的樽裝水，他們形容阿爾卑斯山融雪水的味道最甜，行仔還感到某款水的味道很苦？二人亦試用水質檢測工具測量飲用水機水、水喉水與公園泥水的水質情況，行仔竟差點要喝下泥水……這集請來品水師分享水知識，還指導眾主持如何品評有汽礦泉水。品水師還建議大家生病時宜飲蒸餾水，有甚麼原因？.

programme.title: 按居按揭轉介呈獻:星二代煮飯仔[粵]
programme.desc: 「星二代」Krystal為母親楊思琦準備芝士薯蓉，親自往街市買餸，過程獨立有主見，隨行的主持蔡景行自覺是「多餘的人」！Krystal雙語廣播兼下廚，有板有眼，在旁監察的思琦喜見女兒成長不少。「幫廚」行仔瘋狂自薦，Krystal笑言想叮走他！中場試玩親子問答遊戲，有人大表心痛？思琦回想在《美女廚房》煮到「地裂」，仍自信滿滿，這次助力女兒炮製雞肉串燒，卻公然偷食……親子料理出爐，思琦如何評價女兒廚藝？.

programme.title: 按居按揭轉介呈獻:星二代煮飯仔[粵]
programme.desc: 黃長興偕女兒晞桐亮相《星二代煮飯仔》，爸爸事前評估女兒廚藝僅得二星。晞桐反駁值五星，怎料買菜時竟把芋頭錯認成蒜頭，情況令人擔憂。晞桐挑戰要蒸、炸、焗三重工序的法式雞卷，長興愛女心切在場外頻頻提點。晞桐卻心態輕鬆，更忍不住邊下廚邊偷吃。隨後父女聯手烹調另一道菜，長興被取笑不肯放手讓女兒嘗試。父女問答考驗，長興全猜錯女兒心思。壓軸題，晞桐如帶男朋友回家吃飯，長興會有甚麼反應？晞桐竟認為爸爸會下逐客令！.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 蕭欣浩博士帶行仔造訪元朗懷舊糖水舖，細味手工古法糖水。遠年陳皮紅豆沙陳皮清香，豆粒飽滿；石磨芝麻糊濃稠香滑，配上煙韌湯圓更添滋味；蛋白杏仁茶杏仁味香濃，蛋白嫩滑；馬蹄露配清心丸清潤爽口，口感豐富。蕭博士並細說相關典故。施焯日與波波到中環「掃街」，遍嚐配迷迭香牛油的酸忌廉煙肉碎焗薯、配蒜茸牛油的肉醬焗薯、倫敦過江龍店的正宗手工葡撻及葡國傳統「上帝的麵包」，還有以新鮮水果炮製的手搖特飲，各具特色。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 大廚陳國強帶暉哥到憑珍珠奶茶打響名堂的台灣過江龍餐廳，品嚐台式美食。「人氣」鐵觀音珍珠奶茶層次豐富，珍珠煙韌Ｑ彈；紅燒牛肉麵湯底濃郁，牛肉及牛筋燉煮入味；蝦子蔥油乾拌麵鹹鮮惹味；慢煮豬手滿載膠質精華。黃嘉雯駕車載廖慧儀到東涌海傍的墨西哥餐廳，一邊欣賞飛機升降景致，一邊品嚐佳餚，包括原條燒粟米、慢煮手撕牛肉配香菜飯、墨式香烤雞粟米餅、鐵板烤豬肉配軟粟米餅，以及墨西哥風味朱古力蛋糕，盡享美景與美食。.

programme.title: 貧窮限制想像[粵]
programme.desc: 方紹聰(奶仔)為打破貧窮限制想像的局限，誠邀好友孫慧雪同往體驗逾四萬元一晚的酒店總統套房。二人由司機專車接載、專人接待入住華麗總統套房，享用氣派不凡的十二人會議室、私人桑拿等設施，並有私人管家貼身打點所需。奶仔更包下酒店餐廳款待雪雪，德國大廚奉上「仙氣」牛臉頰肉，佐以「燭光」醬汁……帳單數字有多誇張？這對好友置身總統套房大床上互訴草根童年往事，探討貧窮會否限制想像。奢華過後奶仔記掛的竟是台灣民宿？.

programme.title: 女生素舍[粵]
programme.desc: Fine Dining常會用不同醬汁來提升食物的味道，「全素」廚師Pamela與拍檔Gillian和Michelle，今次就來炮製兩道配上惹味醬汁的美食。首先是「蓮藕餅配羅望子忌廉醬」，羅望子有酸豆之稱，Pam用什麼中和它的酸味？炸得香脆的蓮藕餅內有大豆纖維、甘筍碎等餡料，配上酸甜醬汁，非常開胃！另一道甜品「黑醋士多啤梨酥餅」，Pam加了什麼法寶令酥餅格外鬆脆？她又為何會想到用黑醋醬來配士多啤梨？.

programme.title: Christian In Paris[粵]
programme.desc: 除了電視送飯，改以凱旋門送飯或會更滋味。尚友帶家人來到可遠望凱旋門的餐廳，品嚐蝸牛與田雞兩款法式手工菜，仔仔一試隨即愛上。尚友為子女安排了法式餐桌禮儀課，原來飲杯水的手勢都有要求。行逛位於巴黎第十二區的文森森林，林裡有一間供應地中海菜的沙灘主題餐廳。尚友入座用餐，大讚哈蜜瓜菲達芝士沙律的配搭夠滋味。返回廚房，尚友用田螺替代蝸牛，釀進巨型的貝殼粉中，再配上香煎田雞，成為一道創新的法國料理。.

programme.title: Christian In Paris[粵]
programme.desc: 位於塞納河中間的西提島，是巴黎城區的發源地，尚友踏上最舊的「新橋」，竟發現厲害「鎖事」？經過巴黎聖母院對出廣場，他為何有所感慨？法國菜少豬肉菜式？只要好味就可「上大枱」，吃一口肥美豬腩肉，配得上豎起拇指讚賞。不過，另一招牌菜卻是烤椰菜花？到訪超過五百年歷史的餐廳，品嚐傳統的紅酒燜牛肉，尚友稱吘是近年出自別人之手而最好吃的紅酒燜牛肉，皆因他對炮製這道菜餚亦有一番心得！且留意尚友以慢煮烹調的美味秘訣。.

programme.title: PET PET 觀察團[粵/日]
programme.desc: 以觀察貓狗為主題的綜藝節目，捕捉牠們可愛的一舉一動！.

programme.title: 幫緊你醫緊你[粵/日]
programme.desc: 當我們生病或受傷的時候，最希望有一個可靠的醫生提供意見，節目請來多個醫生，向觀眾講解各種疾病的治療方法、奇難雜症的問與答等等，助你擁有健康人生。.

programme.title: 玲玲友情報[粵]
programme.desc: 這集嘉賓方力申是玲玲姐的好友，也是其眼中的「傳奇人物」。整個訪談過程，小方的想法總是讓玲玲姐滿腦問號，究竟如何才可令他「好好戀愛」呢？玲玲姐更因小方對約會的解讀，笑言他是清朝人，怎料小方竟於對談中找到「同路人」施焯日！玲玲、美貽亦分享對小方的初印象，深入認識後卻被完全扭轉，玲玲姐更曾向葉念琛「投訴」小方？小方還被指是「媽寶」，皆因父母對他太好？小方直言自律性夠高，還因此不敢貿貿然結婚生子？.

programme.title: 冇人性教育[粵][M]
programme.desc: 最後一集，節目舉行「性事常識問答比賽」，由外科醫生兼性治療師發問並擔任評判。首回合「是非題」問到，疫情下日本AV界可會減少拍攝某些場面，有人竟覺得重點鏡頭不可缺？緊接「看字作文題」，波波因同學的表情而銘記「派報紙」意思；也看看眾人圖解「火車便當」姿勢的畫功。終極「搶答題」，各人積極搶分，但當要講出性玩具被禁的地方，不少主持都被考起！另外，兆麟摸黑上山探視「談深地」，並尋找「拋擲膠袋」傳說的蹤跡…….

programme.title: 網紅甜卡[粵]
programme.desc: Christy、Jessica進行街訪，探討巴黎人的早餐文化，接著往麵包店選購特色麵包及甜品，與Veronica在巴黎鐵塔下的戰神廣場野餐、打卡。Veronica預備的貝雷帽份外搶鏡，配戴時有甚麼需注意？她還分享打卡技巧。三人更拆解迷思，嘗試法國風味把牛角包浸泡咖啡來吃，會否中伏？兩位主持造訪巴黎最古老的糕點店及其姊妹朱古力店，試吃鎮店甜品「Rum baba」、朱古力放題……美食背後有甚麼故事？.

programme.title: Christian In Paris[粵]
programme.desc: 除了電視送飯，改以凱旋門送飯或會更滋味。尚友帶家人來到可遠望凱旋門的餐廳，品嚐蝸牛與田雞兩款法式手工菜，仔仔一試隨即愛上。尚友為子女安排了法式餐桌禮儀課，原來飲杯水的手勢都有要求。行逛位於巴黎第十二區的文森森林，林裡有一間供應地中海菜的沙灘主題餐廳。尚友入座用餐，大讚哈蜜瓜菲達芝士沙律的配搭夠滋味。返回廚房，尚友用田螺替代蝸牛，釀進巨型的貝殼粉中，再配上香煎田雞，成為一道創新的法國料理。.

programme.title: 就是愛美麗[粵/普]
programme.desc: 想變靚但不想花太多時間，蔡明思、大久保麻梨子、ZUZU及美肌專家Sam推介省時保養品、美妝及美髮用品，讓女生當一個聰明的懶美人。遊日本想買特產做手信，「東京時尚遊」介紹銀座一間時尚米店，不但嚴選全日本的靚米和各地的食品調味料，店內還有很多優質的生活雜貨。「愛美麗時尚」走訪由台北迪化街布市變身而成的時尚基地，CEO溫筱鴻解釋打造一條龍時裝產業鏈平台的概念。「愛美麗盲測」為四款人氣眼線筆進行汗水測試。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 蕭欣浩博士帶行仔造訪元朗懷舊糖水舖，細味手工古法糖水。遠年陳皮紅豆沙陳皮清香，豆粒飽滿；石磨芝麻糊濃稠香滑，配上煙韌湯圓更添滋味；蛋白杏仁茶杏仁味香濃，蛋白嫩滑；馬蹄露配清心丸清潤爽口，口感豐富。蕭博士並細說相關典故。施焯日與波波到中環「掃街」，遍嚐配迷迭香牛油的酸忌廉煙肉碎焗薯、配蒜茸牛油的肉醬焗薯、倫敦過江龍店的正宗手工葡撻及葡國傳統「上帝的麵包」，還有以新鮮水果炮製的手搖特飲，各具特色。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 大廚陳國強帶暉哥到憑珍珠奶茶打響名堂的台灣過江龍餐廳，品嚐台式美食。「人氣」鐵觀音珍珠奶茶層次豐富，珍珠煙韌Ｑ彈；紅燒牛肉麵湯底濃郁，牛肉及牛筋燉煮入味；蝦子蔥油乾拌麵鹹鮮惹味；慢煮豬手滿載膠質精華。黃嘉雯駕車載廖慧儀到東涌海傍的墨西哥餐廳，一邊欣賞飛機升降景致，一邊品嚐佳餚，包括原條燒粟米、慢煮手撕牛肉配香菜飯、墨式香烤雞粟米餅、鐵板烤豬肉配軟粟米餅，以及墨西哥風味朱古力蛋糕，盡享美景與美食。.

programme.title: OT無限loop
programme.desc: 每晚深夜，公司仲有邊個未收工？有屋企唔返，咁搏命係愛定係責任？閉路電視全程無間斷直擊，《社畜求生101》主角阿星同阿花捱更抵夜職場血淚史！.

programme.title: 兄弟幫[粵]
programme.desc: 歌手馮允謙（Jay Fung）自小熱愛唱歌，十三歲已創作出第一首歌曲；大學畢業後回流香港，在《超級巨聲3》勇奪亞軍。他順理成章加入樂壇，並得到不少新人獎，發展不俗，及後卻陷入事業低潮，有何經歷？轉投新公司後，Jay形容團隊關係猶如一家人，還喜獲師姐王菀之寫歌。電視演出方面，Jay甫入行即可主持旅遊節目《台灣闖蕩》。Jay卻指當年中文太差，拍攝時有甚麼趣事？他又笑言從拍檔胡鴻鈞身上，學到護膚秘訣。.

programme.title: 兄弟幫[粵]
programme.desc: 唱作歌手馮允謙（Jay）兩、三年前遇上事業樽頸，決定外遊散心，順道尋找創作靈感，期間遊歷了亞洲五地。Jay細述在台灣與創作歌手合作寫歌；又難忘於韓國弘大觀賞街頭歌唱表演。他還驚嘆日本人對製作壽司的仔細、認真，教他有感做音樂亦要懷着同樣信念；在新加坡參觀科技藝術展覽，又得到甚麼啟發？馬來西亞行山之旅，Jay偕同另一半挑戰高山，惜中途遇上大雨，無緣登頂。他更對山上餐廳的食物印象深刻，味道有多「出色」？.

programme.title: 旅人視角[粵/普]
programme.desc: 台南人於結婚前有挽面(線面)的指定動作，祐宏體驗這項歷史悠久的美容手藝。挽面還會用上紅線或彩色線，有何原因？光緒十六年已開業的餅店，除了傳統「鳳梨酥」與「綠豆酥」，另有雪糕、香菇魯肉等新派口味！祐宏來到東區黃昏市場，尋找當地人氣美食。市場內有兩款不可錯過的特色小吃，「粿仔」外脆內軟，「春捲」則餡料豐富。喜愛綠色文化的朋友，不妨前往種子主題博物館，內裡提供種子資訊導覽，並展示各式種子藝術品與商品。.

programme.title: 旅人視角[粵/普]
programme.desc: 祐宏在台南自駕尋樂，首站來到以貨櫃堆疊而成的公園。除了有滑草皮等動感玩意之外，也可找到手作坊。煎至金黃酥脆的「燒餅」，正在冒煙亦無阻祐宏的進食慾望，足證有多滋味！他又到訪盛產橄欖的礁坑，覓得啫喱、肥皂等橄欖產品。專為兒童設計的戶外障礙挑戰，祐宏這名「大細路」玩得不亦樂乎。園區旁還有農場，可跟山羊、兔子等動物親密接觸。台南有一種大王蓮花，大家坐在其中仍可浮於水面。祐宏試玩之餘，並品嚐多款蓮產品美食。.

programme.title: 幫緊你醫緊你[粵/日]
programme.desc: 當我們生病或受傷的時候，最希望有一個可靠的醫生提供意見，節目請來多個醫生，向觀眾講解各種疾病的治療方法、奇難雜症的問與答等等，助你擁有健康人生。.

programme.title: 女生素舍[粵]
programme.desc: Fine Dining常會用不同醬汁來提升食物的味道，「全素」廚師Pamela與拍檔Gillian和Michelle，今次就來炮製兩道配上惹味醬汁的美食。首先是「蓮藕餅配羅望子忌廉醬」，羅望子有酸豆之稱，Pam用什麼中和它的酸味？炸得香脆的蓮藕餅內有大豆纖維、甘筍碎等餡料，配上酸甜醬汁，非常開胃！另一道甜品「黑醋士多啤梨酥餅」，Pam加了什麼法寶令酥餅格外鬆脆？她又為何會想到用黑醋醬來配士多啤梨？.

programme.title: 關注關注組[粵]
programme.desc: 芝士常會在焗飯、薄餅中出現之外，也可製成芝士蛋糕，食品種類多元化。大家細談各自對芝士的喜愛，黃嘉雯分享有餐廳採用原個芝士製作意粉；慧儀亦有購買減價芝士的慳錢心得。「日行」這次以芝士蛋糕為目標，外出買來美式連鎖餐廳、星級酒店與網上大熱名店的出品作比拼，哪一款較合他們胃口？大本營內會試食綿羊芝士、牛奶芝士等的四款芝士，某款讓美貽嚐出腐乳味？正好日行也準備了「東方芝士」腐乳配餅乾的吃法，大家有何評語？.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 美食KOL Arthur帶暉哥品嚐韓國「邪惡美食」。薄切牛三角刺身油脂豐腴，入口即融；醬油生醃斑馬瀨尿蝦鮮味濃郁，蝦膏甘香；牛腸鍋包含不同內臟部位，「脂味」十足；炸雞配大閘蟹粉，鮮味大增。位於荔枝角的西班牙餐廳主打該國各地特色佳餚。招牌生烤乳豬皮脆肉嫩，薯仔飽吸肉汁精華；以本地小銀魚、鮮魷及九肚魚炮製的脆炸小食極惹味；紅蝦海鮮飯集海鮮精華於一身；馬德里傳統夾肉包配烤和牛、焦糖洋蔥等配料，層次豐富。.

programme.title: 美食新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 居港越南人Tracy帶伍倩彤品嚐越南地道檬粉。米紙蝦卷包裹檬粉、香菜等配料，加上秘製花生醬，酸爽開胃；蟹膏番茄湯檬鮮味濃郁，蟹膏蛋餅飽吸湯汁精華。此外，順化牛腱米線湯底鮮甜；斑蘭綠豆糕層次分明，同樣不容錯過。黃嘉雯駕車載胡美貽到荃灣的酒店品嚐豐盛美饌。香烤拼盤包羅羊架、串燒及迷你漢堡包等惹味佳餚；特色下午茶套餐則有鴨肝西多士、芒果拿破崙等鹹甜美點，以及由區內老字號食店供應的馳名糯米糍，滋味十足。.

programme.title: 賽馬直擊 - 女皇伊利沙伯二世盃賽馬日[粵/英][馬會]
programme.desc: 女皇伊利沙伯二世盃賽馬日.

programme.title: 台灣潮點圖鑑[粵/普]
programme.desc: 隱身巷弄的選品店，有香氛、藝術家設計的家品及軍用品。怎樣把軍用品應用於現代生活中？且聽奎奎的介紹。.

programme.title: 台灣潮點圖鑑[粵/普]
programme.desc: 在台北，芋頭到訪吸引世界各地旅客前來學煮菜的教室，她的廚藝如何？.

programme.title: 台灣潮點圖鑑[粵/普]
programme.desc: 桃園百年紅樓，英式建築風格及後院的百年拱橋，吸引主持奎奎到來，並在旁邊的老宅咖啡廳品嚐美食。.

programme.title: 最強生命線[粵]
programme.desc: 睡食症是一種發生在睡眠期間的異常行為，病人會在半夢半醒、無意識的狀態下進食，甚至吃下生肉等食物，醒來後往往對過程毫無記憶。此症常見由傳統安眠藥引起，因此對於長期或大量服用安眠藥的病人、長者及曾有病史的人士而言，有睡食症的機率會相對較高。患者亦會因常在夜間無意識進食、煮食而引致危險及導致體重上升。.

programme.title: 東方表行 Take Your Time 呈獻:我和牠的故事[粵]
programme.desc: 樊亦敏一直也愛回家，皆因家中有三隻可愛狗狗，當中Hana和Kuma可謂「松鼠狗姐弟」，時常朝着同一方向。至於臘腸犬Fred被原主人形容「難搞」，亦敏特意由英國越洋接牠回港，望以「愛」感化。其實亦敏也有養兔，兔仔是《開心速遞》的「演員」之一，卻發覺公司環境並不適合牠，遂帶返家飼養。亦敏清楚兔仔所需，也許跟留學時一段錯失經歷有關？暫託爸媽俊其、泳芍於貓貓入屋48小時內的黃金時間，如何為牠們建立安全感？.

programme.title: 師父有請[粵]
programme.desc: 分別有驛⾺相及驛⾺命的黎諾懿、陳敏之，原來曾經有到外地發展的機會！經常出埠⼯作的他們，在外地⾯對極度惡劣的環境⼜如何⾒招拆招？.

programme.title: 關注關注組[粵]
programme.desc: 芫荽又被稱為香菜，不少人對其愛恨分明，坊間更有為「芫荽控」推出特別美食。有指芫荽好處多，除了進食可降血壓之外，用來洗澡還有助舒緩皮膚問題？「日行」本身都對芫荽不太喜愛，外出食好「荽」後可會改觀？他們分別買來融入芫荽的特飲、漢堡、車仔麵與滑蛋三文治，對於美味之選，二人意見分歧？日行這次準備的食品中，粉絲杯麵、魚肉燒賣都被大家投訴芫荽味不足。慧儀提到「爆荽千層蛋糕」的味道像藍芝士，十郎更覺得被整蠱！.

programme.title: 貧窮限制想像[粵]
programme.desc: 視寵物如珠如寶的主人屢見不鮮，但願意為愛寵一擲千金的能有幾人？今集奶仔拜訪對錦鯉情有獨鍾的伍小姐，飼養多條逾百萬元的錦鯉，精心打造逾千萬的魚場，讓魚兒們悠然寫意地暢游。奶仔偕同剛榮升業主的吳紫韻結伴同往長見識。伍小姐細訴與錦鯉結緣經過，養殖錦鯉的血統、飼養水質、魚糧，甚至水深，處處皆學問！她培殖的錦鯉獲奬無數，更在山上自設大型繁殖場，又試養名貴魚種「忘不了」，奶仔和紫韻受其熱誠感染，各自有何得著？.

programme.title: 職工頭圍用膳 東京篇[粵]
programme.desc: 東京一間米芝蓮級數的鳥燒專門店，食物深受食客歡迎，員工的「福食」會否同樣有星級水準？店員早上便要開始處理蔬菜、串串燒等工作，雖然忙碌，各人卻掛著笑臉，氣氛融洽。主持林沚羿幫忙串食材，會否越幫越忙？負責煮一品料理的員工，兼顧煮員工餐，每日要用有限預算構思不同菜式，並要迅速煮好，真的殊不簡單！是日餐單是「麻婆豆腐配炒飯」，滋味如何？店長與員工用餐時會聊什麼話題？沚羿搶先品嚐招牌串燒，到底有何特別？.

programme.title: 京都畫報[粵/日]
programme.desc: 趁著藝術之秋，常盤貴子在作庭家小川勝章的導賞下遊覽多個庭園。涉成園佈局精巧，在指定位置可以看見獨特美景，室內更有版畫家棟方志功的作品。白沙村莊由畫家橋本關雪親自設計，環境饒富詩意。.

programme.title: 鎮鄉之寶[粵/普]
programme.desc: 蠔是台灣嘉義縣東石鄉的鎮鄉之寶，這裡大約八成鄉民都直接或間接參與蠔業養殖的工作。本集主持就帶大家來了解蠔農的日常工作是什麼；蠔業對環境帶來什麼影響；當地居民又如何實現家鄉的永續發展呢？.

programme.title: J. Farm 無添加激素雞件，總代理玖紫八方呈獻 :有GOOD戲 :無間一戰[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 弟弟彭健誠是毒梟集團的頭目，而哥哥彭健忠則是一位緝毒警察，雙方同時捲入到一場毒梟鬥爭中，隨着一場押送毒販的任務，哥哥發現弟弟竟然另有身份，二人為了各自的目的，展開了一場正邪交鋒，無間反轉的緝毒故事...

programme.title: 師父有請[粵]
programme.desc: 分別有驛⾺相及驛⾺命的黎諾懿、陳敏之，原來曾經有到外地發展的機會！經常出埠⼯作的他們，在外地⾯對極度惡劣的環境⼜如何⾒招拆招？.

programme.title: 網紅甜卡[粵]
programme.desc: 法國女性時尚優雅，Christy、Jessica追尋當中不凡魅力，在Veronica引領下先到唇膏店，依個人膚色、衣著挑選不同顏色、質感、香味，打造個人專屬唇膏；再參觀香水品牌博物館，了解香水歷史，調配獨一無二專屬香水，增添女人味！兩位主持隨後拜會法國甜品網紅，學造「雲呢拿朱古力撻」，並以鏡頭捕捉甜品的誘惑，有什麼竅門？兩人又充當當地女攝影師的模特兒，在日照光影中的巴黎街頭，展現令人驚喜的靜態美。.

programme.title: Christian In Paris[粵]
programme.desc: 位於塞納河中間的西提島，是巴黎城區的發源地，尚友踏上最舊的「新橋」，竟發現厲害「鎖事」？經過巴黎聖母院對出廣場，他為何有所感慨？法國菜少豬肉菜式？只要好味就可「上大枱」，吃一口肥美豬腩肉，配得上豎起拇指讚賞。不過，另一招牌菜卻是烤椰菜花？到訪超過五百年歷史的餐廳，品嚐傳統的紅酒燜牛肉，尚友稱吘是近年出自別人之手而最好吃的紅酒燜牛肉，皆因他對炮製這道菜餚亦有一番心得！且留意尚友以慢煮烹調的美味秘訣。.

programme.title: 職工頭圍用膳 東京篇[粵]
programme.desc: 東京一間米芝蓮級數的鳥燒專門店，食物深受食客歡迎，員工的「福食」會否同樣有星級水準？店員早上便要開始處理蔬菜、串串燒等工作，雖然忙碌，各人卻掛著笑臉，氣氛融洽。主持林沚羿幫忙串食材，會否越幫越忙？負責煮一品料理的員工，兼顧煮員工餐，每日要用有限預算構思不同菜式，並要迅速煮好，真的殊不簡單！是日餐單是「麻婆豆腐配炒飯」，滋味如何？店長與員工用餐時會聊什麼話題？沚羿搶先品嚐招牌串燒，到底有何特別？.

programme.title: 就是愛美麗[粵/普]
programme.desc: 掌握時尚運勢，讓你的2019年變得更旺！星座專家安格斯解說「火、土、風、水」四個星象的幸運顏色及物品；美妝專家Minnie則教大家打造開運彩妝。「東京時尚遊」走訪銀座的人氣生活時尚百貨，推薦必買的美妝和護膚品。「網絡紅什麼」教大家利用天然材料，兩分鐘拯救乾唇。「愛美麗時尚」前往台北時尚集中地的永樂市場，參加手工婚紗聯名快閃活動；一系列高級手工婚紗，配以新潮的帽款，突破傳統。.

programme.desc: 每晚深夜，公司仲有邊個未收工？有屋企唔返，咁搏命係愛定係責任？閉路電視全程無間斷直擊，《社畜求生101》主角阿星同阿花捱更抵夜職場血淚史！.

programme.title: The Scarecrow
programme.desc: 故事橫跨 1988 年至 2019 年，描述王牌刑警姜泰周（朴海秀 飾）為破案重返故鄉康盛，遇上負責此案的檢察官車時英（李熙俊 飾）。兩人因目標相同卻關係緊張，不得不放下敵意，共同展開追捕行動.

programme.title: Missing Crown Prince
programme.desc: 王世子被即將成為世子嬪的女人綁架後而發生的一系列故事，在每個瞬間都要拼上性命的逃亡路上，青春男女之間發生的波瀾萬丈，最終逃跑的故事.

programme.title: Bitter Sweet Hell
programme.desc: 盧英媛是大韓民國公認最優秀的家庭心理諮詢醫生，與整形外科醫生丈夫崔宰鎮是所有人都羨慕的夫妻。但突然被不明來歷的神秘女人世娜所威脅，自己曾經令人艷羨的事業與家庭一切都被徹底動搖。為了守護所有家人，開始與作為推理小說作家的家婆洪思江合作守護家人.

programme.title: The Escape of the Seven: Resurrection
programme.desc: 於前作結尾被殺的閔道赫還沒有死去，於是決定向偽裝成整容後的Matthew，實際是被稱作「K」的盛燦集團繼承人報仇.

programme.title: The Vendetta of An
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清.

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清.

programme.title: REBORN
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅.

programme.title: Japan's Number One Jerk Salaryman
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉….

programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅.

programme.title: Japan's Number One Jerk Salaryman
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉….

programme.desc: 面對着新加坡炎熱的天氣、動物的氣味，心情煩躁的晴晴還會參加餘下在動物園的餵食活動嗎？媽媽Natalie又會如何鼓勵囡囡把握這次難能可貴的體驗呢？動物園行程告一段落後，他們一家就來到熟食中心，打算品嚐地道海南雞飯，晴晴會聯同弟弟暘暘一起為父母買飯，過程將會是波折重重或是一帆風順呢？下一站，晹晹即將可以玩他最喜歡的賽車，但因為身高限制，渴望獨立的暘暘必需與爸爸一起才能駕車，失落的他能否好好享受這一次的體驗呢.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: Kathy仔與YOYO來到高雄六龜，接受任務“逗遊包”，品嚐了在地美食後，往山裡終於找尋到彩虹山大佛。位於高雄六龜的「彩虹山大佛」，高24米大約七層樓高，共使用了 167噸的銅雕鑄而成，莊嚴慈目聳立於中央山脈間，居高臨下俯瞰眾生，充滿寧靜祥和的氣度。佛身下方有塊重達6892公斤的緬甸翡翠玉石，被譽為鎮山之寶.

programme.title: FWD Presents: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 本集《CHILL CLUB》請來周柏豪，今集主題是「情緒未讀」。有時我們習慣照顧別人的感受，卻忽略了自己內心真正的情緒。無論是愛情中的不安與遺憾，還是生活中難以啟齒的心聲，都未必能夠輕易說出口。今集周柏豪將以多首歌曲，帶大家走進不同的情感世界，除了重溫自己的經典作品，亦會挑戰其他歌手的歌曲，呈現男人在感情中不同的一面。此外，節目亦會送上「CHILL CLUB 推介榜」，為樂迷揭曉本週十大推介歌曲的最新排名.

programme.title: Hello, Mt Fuji!
programme.desc: 十萬年來，水質優良的富士山雪水都在滋潤大地，至今周邊居民同樣以此賴以維生， 也形成了各種美麗的奇觀，今集帶大家去富士山「打水」，參觀富士山形成的忍野八海，吃用富士山水造做的麵包和泡足湯，到新倉淺間神社祈求登山順利.

programme.title: Never Dive Alone
programme.desc: 最後迎來Lezlie的個人挑戰—於地形崎嶇的潛點獨自完成尋寶任務！眾人到達潛點後，因天氣不佳，是次潛水因安全理由被逼取消。Lezlie失望之餘亦透露個人挑戰對她意義重大，希望透過挑戰證明自己這般體型，仍能自由潛水。製作組嘗試再為Lezlie安排挑戰機會，可惜行程緊湊，到底最終Lezlie可否如願以償，進行挑戰.

programme.title: COLLAR Reset Go
programme.desc: 來到知名野生動物世界，除了可以跟猴子及老虎見面打卡外，原來仲可以體驗刺激的高空攀爬，玩到Winka、Candy、Ivy嗌足全場！ 阿Day旅程中還靈魂出竅，突然失憶激死經理人.

programme.title: Guardians of the Memory
programme.desc: 除了Classic Car，在日本單車、甚至軍車也有守護者。今集兩位嘉賓，一位利用昭和時代零件訂製世上獨一無二的復古單車，一位把軍車維修並以「動態」形式保存，讓大家能夠親身感受，Sica更會坐上裝甲車在日本遊街.

programme.title: MM730 - Beast fight game
programme.desc: 本星期困獸鬥迎來了洪嘉豪生日特輯。大家除了要陪壽星嘉豪玩遊戲外，製作組亦悉心準備了一系列隱藏任務給困獸鬥成員來為嘉豪慶生。好勝心極強的大家是否會讓嘉豪在遊戲中取勝，還是認真鬥上一番呢.

programme.title: Mini Maker E18 -剪紙藝術家
programme.desc: 剪紙手藝博大精深，難怪其歷史可以如此源遠流長。它之能夠世代傳承，當然還有賴不斷有像葉詠欣這種剪紙藝術家，不懈地為手藝添上時代新元素。今集主持人和小學徒，也會跟著老師學以一把剪刀一張紙，剪出美麗奥妙的奇幻世界.

programme.title: News Cast at 6 with Sign Language
Now Forum
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: Like My Parents
programme.desc: 韋飛雄小時候看爸爸韋瑞群在舞台上變臉，最深刻的不是那一張張瞬間變換的臉譜有多神奇，而是他每次演出後，仍然專注練習、一絲不苟的背影。長大後，她打破「傳男不傳女」的傳統，跟隨爸爸走入變臉世界。她沒有成為第二個韋瑞群，而是用自己的方式，把這門古老技藝注入現代節奏與創新臉譜。兩人分別站在不同的舞台位置，卻共同守護同一份中華絕技，讓變臉繼續在香港發光.

programme.title: Broker
programme.desc: 尚賢（宋康昊 飾）經營洗衣店，可惜生意淡靜更負債纍纍。好兄弟東洙（姜棟元 飾）本身是孤兒，為「嬰兒暫存箱」機構工作。在一個雨夜，他們竟秘密帶走其中一個箱裡的男嬰。翌日，年輕的母親素英（李知恩 飾）卻找上門要求領回自己的孩子羽星！本想報警揭發，但素英最終竟同意讓兩個「中間人」為兒子尋覓更好的父母，並決定跟隨兩人同行。另一邊廂，刑警秀珍（裴斗娜 飾）聯同後輩李刑警（李周映 飾）原來一直跟蹤著他們，暗中收集證據，決心拉人定案！由暫存箱裡的嬰兒引發，牽連周遭5個關鍵人物，展開一段意想不到的獨特旅程，觸動最微妙的世故人情.

programme.title: Be a Better Man
programme.desc: 在南丫島上兩天，六位男士展現出不同好男友特質，但何謂最佳? 何不來一場即席互選，投票選出誰是最佳男友，勝出更可與女友作短暫交流。常聽說女友覺得甜蜜之事，皆來自於男友細微關心，假若男友們學懂如何替女友吹得一頭好髮，是否就能be a better man? 一切就視乎南丫島「四大美人」是否吹得滿意.

programme.title: ERROR 10M ROCK N ROAD
programme.desc: 死腳膠為了音樂靈感，冒性命危險登山，想感受神秘自然之力.

programme.title: Guardians of the Memory
programme.desc: 除了Classic Car，在日本單車、甚至軍車也有守護者。今集兩位嘉賓，一位利用昭和時代零件訂製世上獨一無二的復古單車，一位把軍車維修並以「動態」形式保存，讓大家能夠親身感受，Sica更會坐上裝甲車在日本遊街.

programme.title: MIRROR Gone Wild
programme.desc: 講起香港飲食文化，必定會想起蛋撻奶茶！今集Ian、Jer到訪已有數十年歷史的舊咖啡室，與熱愛研究茶餐廳的蕭欣浩博士上一課「茶餐廳」課.

programme.title: Weird Superstition in Taiwan
programme.desc: 今集走訪了土城大墓公廟及位於石碇的五路財神廟，專門保佑人們尋失物和求財，而為了勝出，三位嘉賓都出盡法寶，浩南更拿出她的私人護身符來保佑勝出，而Isabella最後到底獲得甚麼終極獎品而令她不敢收下.

programme.title: Dreaming
programme.desc: 龐景峰夢中亂槍擊殺喪屍，再有財神騎呢出現；拆夢反映他對父母離異心存憤恨，曾經嬲爆小豪哥。單親家庭成長的保錡見父子冰釋前嫌，感動羨慕.

programme.title: All for One
programme.desc: 足球、籃球經理人可能聽得比較多，美式足球隊經理人你又聽過了沒有？今集為大家介紹一項在香港比較罕有的運動項目－美式足球，而身為球隊背後支柱的經理人Jason，這個角色可以說是舉足輕重，而Jason 更會分享身為一個幕僚的心路歷程.

programme.title: The Culture Book
programme.desc: 當速寫畫家走進文化館，他會如何傳承傳統文化？今集繼續聽聽他的分享，並教導主持人體驗速寫.

programme.title: The Alternative Classroom
programme.desc: 婚禮策劃公司創辦人兼資深婚禮策劃師 - Queenly，擁逾20年海外及本地婚禮籌劃經驗。精通跨國婚姻法律流程，開創日本、歐洲及關島等地的合法婚書代辦服務，並帶領專業團隊提供由場地策劃、花藝設計至當日流程統籌的一站式海外婚禮服務.

programme.title: Green Finder
programme.desc: 廚餘的妙用如何在校園間推廣，讓學生參與更多相關工作？今集繼續聽聽嘉賓的分享.

programme.title: Unhumble Cooking
programme.desc: 這一集製作組決定要３位主持自己的事自己做，一直過度倚賴幕後同事的 WinWin 同 George 笑話百出，有賴淡定賢淑的嘉倩從旁協助。George 得到 Christian 幫忙完成「黯然銷魂羊肉义燒飯」。嘉倩同 WinWin 合作的啤酒雜菜燉羊膝，雖然未致於嘥料，不過效果就不似預期.

programme.title: One Day Dating
programme.desc: 這個節目真是逆天的Marco自肥計劃！第八位女嘉賓竟是混血美女！混血女生除了擁有強大的基因之外，更總帶著貴公主氣質，男生無不為之傾倒，但卻又感覺遙不可及！但今集這位女神卻有著親和的個性，對Marco來說簡直是天大的好消息！就連神隊友Pheobus及Geroge都忍不住高呼不公平！甚至一同參與了約會日，成為兩枚閃耀的電燈膽！四人約會究竟是怎樣的狀況呢.

programme.title: Priceless Meal
programme.desc: 產後婦女需要坐月，原來流產婦女也需要「坐小月」？身為過來人的 Jan，深感社會對流產婦女的支援不足，令她決心推出「小月餐」，照顧她們的身心需要.

programme.title: Silver Start-up E4 -逆風領袖
programme.desc: 蔡崇機（機哥）從事教育工作40年，退休後放下校長身份，培訓退休及半退休人士成為「逆風領袖」，走入校園與年輕人交流。今集主持將了解他如何帶領銀髮族學習放下身段，以人生經驗連繫兩代，延續教育界心靈工程師的力量.

programme.title: Get Health Savvy E5 -多發性骨髓瘤
Hello Jadoo
programme.desc: 故事背景為1978至1980年，敘述小梅子一家人，以及身邊的朋友同學的溫馨趣味故事.

programme.title: All for One
programme.desc: 「我從沒有放棄過去接觸山，我的付出與成果完全成正比，因為我真的很喜愛這工作」。你能想像攝影師為了拍攝而上山下海的畫面嗎？背後所需的體力絕對不簡單。例如運動員高速前進或停下來思索更有利的路線，攝影師也同樣要全程緊貼，加上揹著至少重十公斤器材。當遇上紀錄大自然的情況，也不會因同一條路線已走過無數次而感到無聊.

programme.title: Study Tour with Fun
programme.desc: 「施比受更為有福」很多家長都會教導小孩，但要讓小孩真正明白句子的意思，家長是要直接與小孩一同參與不同義工活動讓其明白當中真諦。今集朱薰、Ash、Alice、Sean、Trixie 和 Taylor 會一同前往一間機構參與不同義工服務，讓他們學習感受別人的感受，同時珍惜現在所擁有的生活.

programme.title: Sound and Vision
programme.desc: 《空白格》講述為遏止自殺潮，聯邦政府派遣調查員，找出潛在情緒病患者。然而，身為調查員的Tracy卻遭到匿名舉報⋯⋯今集請來導演和歌手上來分享拍攝故事.

programme.title: Night Vibes Asia
programme.desc: 今集，Yoshi同Anton將會遇上三位特別嘉賓——先有旅居韓國近10年嘅香港人Amanda，帶兩位乘坐夜間快車欣賞首爾靚景，再去本地人最愛嘅海鮮市場食大餐；隨後再有Viu原創劇《完美的家族》嘅導演行定勳、演員金永大，從中八卦佢哋喺韓國拍戲時嘅夜生活。而Yoshi同Anton兩位戲精隨後仲忍唔住喺寺廟上演「狗血劇情」.

programme.title: Battle of the Throne 2
programme.desc: 繼續台北集訓之旅，4強選手分別拜訪移居台灣發展的香港音樂單位絕命青年及潘緻慧、有搖滾奶奶之稱的75歲女鼓手寶秀姐、更與Elsie展開了解內心世界的對話、以及接觸大自然，來一趟與自己對話的身心靈之旅….

programme.title: Force of Love
programme.desc: 今集戰場移師至中環碼頭，進行多場鬥力量的賽事，包括拗手膼、四角繩等。下半場賽事則與中學拔河隊進行拔河比賽，一眾大力情人情到底會否贏出賽事.

programme.title: Pay less, Play more
programme.desc: 日本的古怪比賽新奇有趣，卻同時充份表現日本人的堅毅精神。今集Win Win親身參與於發祥地京田辺舉辦的「ISU-1GP」，跟日本人一較高下.

programme.title: GYM Room Stories
programme.desc: 有人健身講究度身訂造，個人健身教練就能投其所好：PT兼係物理治療師，健身得療傷都得; 女性個人健身教練，了解女性生理需要仲兼顧心靈需要。不過，亦都有人不愛獨享教練嘅全部注意，偏要一大班人眾樂樂先有動力。兩種尖房生態，邊碟鹹魚邊碟青菜？佢哋又點各得擁躉所愛.

programme.title: After School Playtime
programme.desc: 一般籃球比賽由五位球員對五位，而今日要介紹的三人籃球，顧名思義就是三對三的形式。三人籃球最早源自美國街頭文化，直到2007年國際籃總正式制定官方規則後，便逐漸發展成為各大綜合運動會的常設項目。今屆亞運會同樣將三人籃球列入正式比賽項目.

programme.title: News Cast at 6 with Sign Language
Now Forum
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界.

programme.title: now Report
programme.desc: 專題式深入報道香港及世界熱門時事.

programme.title: Employers' Federation of Hong Kong Presents: Good Employer Unlocked
programme.desc: 人工高、福利好，就等於好僱主？其實一個真正的好僱主，除了給員工合理待遇之外, 還需要懂得關心員工、重視發展，同時打造理想的工作環境。《解鎖好僱主》走訪不同行業的優秀企業，透過管理層的真實分享，拆解成功企業背後的管理智慧，一齊發掘新時代的「好僱主」.

programme.title: Holidays For The Animals
programme.desc: 原來華欣巴蜀府也有一望無際的葡萄園，除了以廢棄酒桶改造成犀鳥巢箱，亦有照顧大象。Yoyo前往狗狗救援中心，帶受傷狗狗到沙灘「放風」，更走上街頭與流浪狗建立信任關係，目標是捕捉、絕育、放回.

programme.title: Wish you good health
programme.desc: 一次頭痛、流鼻水、咳嗽，看似是小病，其實可能屬於某一種嚴重疾病的先兆! 大家應好好認識不同病症，以防患於未然，或及時對症下藥! 本節目將搜羅各醫科常見的都市病，或奇難雜症，觀眾難於啟齒的身體問題.

programme.title: The Popcorn Show 4
programme.desc: 《爆谷一周》返嚟喇！作為全城最重磅影視娛樂訪談節目，今輯繼續為觀眾請來最新話題大作的焦點人物，盡訴幕後心中情，演員主創齊齊不設底線談天講地！除介紹令人翹首以待的首輪猛片，更有多集以香港影壇經典為主題，邀來各路影視英雄將影畫史娓娓道來，一同回顧經典，細述用無盡汗水鋪出的光影路！另設全新環節貼身追蹤電影生力軍嘅日常，了解他們不懈籌備新作的苦與樂！《爆谷一周》重裝上陣，共你一同穿梭香港電影的「現在」、「過去」與「未來」.

programme.title: FWD Presents: CHILL CLUB
programme.desc: 不同年代也會誕生著不同的流行曲。開心時，你會聽著某些流行曲；悲傷時，你會聽著某些流行曲，這些流行曲總伴隨著你我長成。《CHILL CLUB》透過主持駱振偉，聯同每集不同嘉賓，唱出不同年代的流行曲，重塑各個觀眾對那些流行曲的情懷及回憶。而且，每一集都會有「新歌推介」，令觀眾也可得知現時最新的流行曲.

programme.title: Crayon Shinchan
programme.desc: 臼井儀人漫畫作品。五歲小孩野原新之助（小新）百厭趣怪，個性誇張自戀，是最令人頭痛的小朋友。小新與父親廣志、母親美冴、妹妹小葵住在埼玉縣的春日部市，最愛領著「雙葉幼稚園」的朋友你搞冒險，在日常生活中製造無數瘋狂趣事.

programme.title: SPY×FAMILY Season 3
programme.desc: 伯林特綜合醫院診療部部長──傑瑞德，因妒忌優秀又受人愛戴的洛伊德搶走了自己的地位，便處心積慮地對他百般刁難。即使如此，洛伊德的名聲依舊毫無動搖，這讓傑瑞德更加憤恨不平。最終，他竟然捏造洛伊德是間諜的罪名，向保安局舉報…\r\n\r\n安妮亞要去參加社會科戶外教學。在搭乘校車前往的途中，她滿懷幹勁地準備對達米安展開「好朋友作戰」，卻總是不順利。就在這時，激進派組織「赤紅馬戲團」竟然劫持了校車.

programme.title: Be An Acting Star
programme.desc: 完成復活賽後，34人晉級第二回合。今次以三人一組來重新分組。製作組抽籤選出一人後，再由他自選組員。其後比賽很快展開，首場比賽有阿業和安信再次碰頭，繼第一回合後再次進行對決.

programme.title: Rovko

programme.desc: Privatna opera. G. Bean mora kupiti karte za odlazak na operu s Irmom, no sve su rasprodane. Stoga dovodi Signor Parmigiana na privatan nastup pred njim i Irmom.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Leminške smetnje. Grizzy je pripremio večeru koji je kanio jesti pred televizorom gledajući omiljenu seriju. Ali njegov užitak iznenada prekida neočekivana statika.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Visokonaponski medvjeđi napad. Leminzi su organizirali rave zabavu. Kad Grizzy baci njihovu glazbenu liniju u rijeku, izazove nestanak struje te ne može gledati omiljene serije.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Medvjeđi mirisi. Kad shvati da njegova voljena medvjedica voli miris cvijeća, Grizzy joj pokloni iglice koje ukrašavaju prozorske daske rendžerove kolibe.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Medvjeđa sreća. Danas nije Grizzyjev dan: nakon što se osramotio pred medvjedicom, leminzi ga izbacuju iz kolibe. No sreća će mu se ubrzo ponovno osmijehnuti.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Magnetski medvjed. Grizzy ne može vjerovati očima kad vidi da se predmeti kreću sami od sebe. Ubrzo shvaća da se leminzi igraju magnetom.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Medvjeđi šarm. Grizzy je uvjeren da se medvjedica koju voli pretvorila u žabu. Dok čita rendžerove bajke, leminzi traže žabu.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Medvjedov najbolji prijatelj. Grizzy nalazi maloga rakuna nedaleko od kolibe. Kad ugleda njegove velike suzne oči, Grizzy se rastapa od miline i posvaja stvorenje.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Grizzyjeva utrka. Grizzy otkriva čar videoigara na rendžerovoj konzoli. I leminzi se žele okušati na kontroleru, no Grizzy odbija prekinuti utrke u kartingu.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Lažni brat. Grizzy izrađuje robotskog dvojnika koji će tjerati leminge dok priprema zabavu za voljenu medvjjedicu. No umjetna inteligencija njegova dvojnika nije na razini zadatka.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Pomućen um. Kad pretrpi udarac u glavu, medvjedica u koju je zaljubljen Grizzy misli da je leming.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Poveći problem. Kad meteorit padne nedaleko od kolibe, počnu rasti neobične bobice. Jedno od njihovih svojstava jest nesrazmjeran rast kod onih koji ih pojedu.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Medvjeđe blago. Ispod drvena poda kolibe Grizzy i leminzi otkrivaju ulaz u podzemnu galeriju sa starom kartom koja pokazuje gdje je zakopano blago.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: U službi Njegova Veličanstva. Kad uzme indijsko žezlo koje su donijeli leminzi, Grizzy primjećuje da se leminzi klanjaju pred njim i ponašaju poput sluga.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Medvjeđa umjetnost. Grizzy pokušava zadiviti medvjedicu u koju je zaljubljen izrađivanjem njezina kipa od drveta. Ali leminzi glođu umjetničko djelo kako bi napravili tobogan.

programme.title: Grizli I Plavi Glodavci
programme.desc: Sretan rođendan, leminzi!. Leminzi priređuju rođendansku proslavu za jednoga od njih. Kad se zaori "Sretan rođendan", Grizz je iznenađen koliko i slavljenički leming.

programme.title: Gospodin Bean: Crtana Serija
programme.desc: Prohujalo lišće. G. Bean ne zna kamo s lišćem s travnjaka i traži kamo ga otpuhati puhačem za lišće, pri čemu nehotice osujeti pljačku banke.

programme.title: Gospodin Bean: Crtana Serija
programme.desc: Lovac na autograme. G. Bean čeka u ogromnom redu za autogram omiljene akcijske zvijezde pa se preruši u zaštitara kako bi preskočio red. Hoće li dobiti autogram?

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Mrlja na kauču. Irma i g. Bean idu na večeru k Paliwalima. G. Paliwal se hvali novim bijelim kaučem, koji Bean zamrlja čokoladom. Hoće li ga uspjeti oprati?

programme.title: Mr. Bean
programme.desc: Beanov salon za ljubimce. Gđa Wicket šalje Beana u salon za ljubimce, no on odluči sam urediti Scrappera i zadržati ostatak novca te u vrtu otvoriti vlastiti salon za ljubimce.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Modna revija. Glavni modni događaj sezone uskoro će započeti! Doktori Lamputa prate na pozornicu i uništavaju doživljaj. Ubrzo se svi upuštaju u kratki i bolni hod po pisti. Boja sezone je narančasta.

programme.title: Rovko
programme.desc: Supertalent u Krtoviku. Rovko odluči organizirati Supertalent, no kad vidi da u Krtoviku baš i nema nadarenih, boji se da će šou propasti.

programme.title: Rovko
programme.desc: Sveznalica. Rovko je frustriran što ne zna dobro rješavati križaljke, pa se posluži čarolijom koja ga pretvara u "sveznalicu".

programme.title: Rovko
programme.desc: Sajam izuma. Rovko i njegova majka natječu se na godišnjem Mišmašovu sajmu izuma, a za to vrijeme Vrtlar i Gmiz kuju planove kako ukrasti Priku.

programme.title: Rovko
programme.desc: Zatvoreni. Rovko i Nora ostanu zatočeni u Mišmašovu laboratoriju, gdje se uključuje vrlo složeni sigurnosni sustav.

programme.title: Rovko
programme.desc: Krtan Burki. Krtan, divovska, naprasita, pustolovna krtica koja se hvali opasnim pustolovinama, stiže u grad kako bi povela Rovka na jednu od tih pustolovina.

programme.title: Tom I Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Fluffy! Bakery. Legendarni junaci vraćaju se u potpuno drugačijem izdanju: razigrano istražuju svakodnevni život, pun mira, prijateljstva i zabavnog nadmetanja. Ne propustite ovu simpatičnu avanturu!

programme.title: Muh Muh I Gljivani
programme.desc: Posebna kućica. Gljivuljci nikako da ostave Beti malo na miru. Beti je ushićena nakon pronalaska puževe kućice, ali je ne želi dijeliti s ostalima.

programme.title: Muh Muh I Gljivani
programme.desc: Trenerica Blagva. Kada Blagva trenira Mrgu da bude u formi, brži i jači, ona postaje nova Blagva: neka koja zahtijeva izvrsnost i punu predanost! Jadni Mrga!

programme.title: Muh Muh I Gljivani
programme.desc: Pjesma šume. Tartuf stvara glazbu s lakoćom. Ali za stvaranje pjesme šume, ipak će se morati malo više potruditi.

programme.title: Muh Muh I Gljivani
programme.desc: Kip. Beti obožava Lisičičine rukotvorine. Ali nije oduševljena kipom koji joj je Lisičica izradila. Hoće li joj Beti to i priznati?

programme.title: Sausage Party
programme.desc: U ovom računalno animiranom filmu za odrasle jedna kobasica povede skupinu proizvoda iz supermarketa u potragu za istinom o njihovu postojanju i onome što se zaista događa kada budu odabrani da...

programme.title: Matvey I Beate Idu Na Kupanje
programme.desc: Krhka priča o početku prijateljstva između Matveya koji je nedavno emigrirao iz Moskve u Berlin i Beate, mještanke slobodnog duha.

programme.title: Pripravnici
programme.desc: Dva nezaposlena trgovca odluče se dokazati kroz pripravništvo u Googleu, gdje se moraju nadmetati s mlađim kolegama.

programme.title: Pijanistov Izbor
programme.desc: U osvit Drugog svjetskog rata François Touraine, virtuoz na klaviru, nema druge nego otići svirati u Njemačku kako bi spasio svoju učiteljicu.

programme.title: Strvinari
programme.desc: Novinar Samuel i njegova kći, pripravnica Ava izvještavaju o brutalnom ubojstvu mlade djevojke i otkrivaju sličnosti s ubojstvom druge žene.

programme.title: Ribe
programme.desc: Nakon što Rona prekine kontakt s obitelji u Izraelu i preseli se u Japan, iznenađujući telefonski poziv o smrti njezine sestre potresa njezin svijet.

programme.title: Interstellar
programme.desc: Dok se naše vrijeme na Zemlji bliži kraju, ekipa istraživača krene na najvažniju misiju u ljudskoj povijesti: put izvan ove galaksije kako bi otkrili ima li čovječanstvo budućnost među zvijezdama.

programme.title: Grad Laži
programme.desc: Osramoćeni detektiv losanđeleske policije Russell Poole (Johnny Depp) s novinarom Jackom Jacksonom (Forest Whitaker) otkriva istinu iza ubojstava glazbenih ikona Tupaca Shakura i Christophera...

programme.title: Tessa
programme.desc: Nastassia Kinski glumi siromašnu seljanku poslanu da živi sa svojim dalekim i bogatim rođacima, samo da bi postala žrtvom zavođenja i prijevare.

programme.title: Strvinari
programme.desc: Novinar Samuel i njegova kći, pripravnica Ava izvještavaju o brutalnom ubojstvu mlade djevojke i otkrivaju sličnosti s ubojstvom druge žene.

programme.desc: Na zabačenom otoku moguće zatvaranje lokalne tvornice ribe poklapa se s borbom mladića da spriječi raspad svoje obitelji.

programme.desc: Patricka je majka kao bebu ostavila na stubama župnog dvora u njihovu irskom gradiću.

programme.desc: Jedina je želja smrtno bolesne Gilde umrijeti bez boli, a kako svi njezini pokušaji samoubojstva komično propadaju, odlučuje potražiti stručnu pomoć.

programme.desc: Ebb Tide. Žica je najrealističnija, beskompromisna i najiskrenija policijska dramska serija koja se prikazivala na televiziji.

programme.title: Zlatna Groznica

programme.title: Božićna Nasljednica
programme.desc: Kao test karaktera, baka nasljednice Loryn šalje je da radi u obiteljskoj robnoj kući tijekom iznimno prometnog božićnog razdoblja.

programme.title: Božićni Casanova
programme.desc: Stvari poprime neočekivani preokret kada podcaster Elise pristane pomoći Daniyalu da stvori nezaboravno božićno iskustvo da bi pridobio staru ljubav.

programme.title: Dobra Vještica
programme.desc: Isprike i sjećanja. Dok Festival tradicije u Middletonu izaziva pometnju, Cassie dočekuje uplašenu mladu ženu u Sivoj kući i saznaje da je netko prati.

programme.title: Dobra Vještica
programme.desc: Bijeg od straha. Cassien misteriozni gost nestaje, a radnja se još više zahuktava kad se još nekoliko novih lica pojavi u gradu prije tradicijskog bala.

programme.title: Talijanska Božićna Sjećanja
programme.desc: Brat i sestra Collucia pokušavaju rekreirati poznati umak za tjesteninu svoje pokojne bake kako bi oživjeli sjećanje djeda koji boluje od demencije.

programme.title: Čudo U Američkom Betlehemu
programme.desc: Mary Ann je slobodna žena koja je usvojila bebu neposredno prije Božića. Zbog lošeg vremena zaglave u Betlehemu i moraju ostati kod stranca.

programme.title: Božićni Popis, Drugi Dio
programme.desc: Part 2. Dok Emily radi na ispunjenju posljednje želje svoje preminule majke, ona i Noah, novinar koji prati priču, postaju sve bliskiji.

programme.title: Božićno Selo
programme.desc: Kad nacionalni časopis odabere Brookfield za prikaz božićnog duha, mještani se udružuju kako bi pretvorili grad u blagdanski čarobni svijet.

programme.title: U Ovo Doba Svake Godine
programme.desc: Iako su rastavljeni, Lauren nagovara Kevina da su još sretan par kada joj majka dolazi u posjet. Može li njihova obmana ponovno probuditi ljubav?

programme.title: Radosna Gđa Čudo Debbie Macomber
programme.desc: Rivalstvo među braćom i sestrama prijeti razjediniti troje nasljednika tvrtke. A onda u upravu stiže gđa Miracle kako bi unijela božićnu čaroliju.

programme.title: Riskiraj Na Božić
programme.desc: Nakladnicu i samohranu majku Sutton čeka radni odmor, sve dok mladi sin Jae ne isplete božićnu čaroliju koja je odvede do romanse i ugovora za knjigu.

programme.title: Šansa Za Božić
programme.desc: Influencerica Christina Chance je oduševljena kada dobije priliku surađivati sa svojim omiljenim brendom, no s time dolaze i brojni izazovi. Hoće li Kristina uspjeti izdržati pod pritiskom?

programme.title: Nova Božićna Ljubav
programme.desc: U susret Božiću, Ashley Durreau i Scott Briggs, oboje tek izašli iz romantične veze, upravo su stigli u Idaho Falls.

programme.title: Božićni Popis, Prvi Dio
programme.desc: Part 1. Lokalni pisac Noah prati priču Emily, pred kojom je zastrašujući izazov ispunjenja posljednje želje preminule majke: božićne liste od 12 zadataka.

programme.title: Božićni Popis
programme.desc: Carley se odluči uhvatiti u koštac s prošlogodišnjim popisom božićnih odluka, počevši s otpuštanjem s posla! Ljubav pronalazi sa sinom svog šefa.

programme.title: #božić
programme.desc: Prijavljujući se na natjecanje kao influencerica, Jen dolazi do finala i suočava se s dilemom: zadržati lažnu obitelj ili reći istinu.

programme.title: Dobra Vještica
programme.desc: Postupi ispravno. Cassie se teško nosi sa svojom nestašnom rođakinjom Abigail, koja se ponovno pojavljuje u Middletonu i odmah očarava Sama i Grace.

programme.title: Dobra Vještica
programme.desc: Sve ostaje u obitelji. Spletkarenje rođakinje Abigail i dalje stvara probleme Cassie, dok Martha planira obnoviti grad kako bi unaprijedila svoju političku karijeru.

programme.title: Uzgajalište Božićnih Drvaca
programme.desc: Jessica vodi najpopularniju farmu božićnih drvaca u gradu, no zbog novog lanca trgovina marketinškog direktora Claya mogla bi ostati bez posla.

programme.title: Otvoriti Do Božića
programme.desc: Nicky pronađe neotvorenu božićnu čestitku od tajnog obožavatelja iz srednje škole i s najboljom prijateljicom kreće u potragu za anonimnim autorom.

programme.title: Ne Baš Kraljevski Božić
programme.desc: Novinarka Charlotte traži intervju s nedostižnim grofom, ali joj namjeste Adama, vrtlara na imanju. Hoće li se lažnjak napokon pokazati iskrenim?

programme.title: Pub Kviz Kod Svetog Nikole
programme.desc: U sveučilišnom gradiću u Vermontu vrijeme je za godišnji božićni pub kviz, a astronomkinja Celeste nađe se u istom timu s nogometnim trenerom Maxom.

programme.title: Želimo Vam Bračni Božić
programme.desc: Beccin i Robbiejev brak zapao je u krizu. Po savjetu bračnog savjetnika, odlaze u seoski pansion nadajući se da će se ponovno zbližiti tijekom Božića.

programme.title: Suđeni Za Božić
programme.desc: Kim i Theo upoznaju se na Crni petak dok šopingiraju i frcaju iskre. Ali se razdvoje zbog nestanka struje pa se stvari moraju staviti na čekanje.

programme.title: Suđeni 2: Ponovno Božić
programme.desc: Theo pokušava zaprositi Kim, ali prvo izgubi prsten, a onda sve što mu može poći po zlu pođe po zlu! Hoće li se snaći?

programme.title: Dvanaest Spojeva Do Božića
programme.desc: Prva epizoda prve Hallmarkove romantične mini-serije, adaptirane prema bestseleru Jenni Bayliss, snimane na lokacijama u Britaniji i Irskoj.

programme.title: Dvanaest Spojeva Do Božića
programme.desc: Druga epizoda prve Hallmarkove romantične mini-serije, adaptirane prema bestseleru Jenni Bayliss, snimane na lokacijama u Britaniji i Irskoj.

programme.title: Moj Božićni Vodič
programme.desc: Nakon što je izgubio vid, profesor Trevor usvaja psa vodiča od trenerice Peyton. Provođenje vremena s njima pomaže mu da ponovno otvori svoje srce.

programme.title: Veseli Božić
programme.desc: Četvero braće i sestara nevoljko se vraća kući za blagdane. Svi još moraju učiti o odrastanju, a onda gradom počne harati misteriozni piroman.

programme.title: Nova Božićna Ljubav
programme.desc: U susret Božiću, Ashley Durreau i Scott Briggs, oboje tek izašli iz romantične veze, upravo su stigli u Idaho Falls.

programme.title: Primite Bezvremenske Čestitke
programme.desc: Kad Ally naslijedi bakinu trgovinu s ručno rađenim čestitkama, Bennett je nagovori da ponovno pokrene staru obiteljsku djelatnost.

programme.title: Dobra Vještica
programme.desc: Istina o lažima. S mećavom koja samo što nije pogodila grad, Cassie mora uvjeriti Nicka u svoju intuiciju kako bi spriječila tragičan preokret.

programme.title: Dobra Vještica
programme.desc: Oluja. Dok oluja ne pokazuje znakove popuštanja, a grad je još uvijek pod opsadom snijega, Cassie i Sam udružuju snage u misiji spašavanja života.

programme.title: Ti Si Božić
programme.desc: Emma nastoji pridobiti bivšeg, Tylera, glazbenu zvijezdu, za svoju diskografsku kuću, istovremeno pokušavajući spasiti proslavu Božića.

programme.title: Talijanska Božićna Sjećanja
programme.desc: Brat i sestra Collucia pokušavaju rekreirati poznati umak za tjesteninu svoje pokojne bake kako bi oživjeli sjećanje djeda koji boluje od demencije.

programme.title: U Ovo Doba Svake Godine
programme.desc: Iako su rastavljeni, Lauren nagovara Kevina da su još sretan par kada joj majka dolazi u posjet. Može li njihova obmana ponovno probuditi ljubav?

programme.title: Riskiraj Na Božić
programme.desc: Nakladnicu i samohranu majku Sutton čeka radni odmor, sve dok mladi sin Jae ne isplete božićnu čaroliju koja je odvede do romanse i ugovora za knjigu.

programme.title: Princeza Božićnih Zvončića
programme.desc: Uslijed nesporazuma, princeza bogatašica primorana je božićne praznike provesti sa sasvim običnom obitelji u malom gradu.

programme.title: Božić U Evergreenu: Zvončići
programme.desc: Bliži se Michelleino vjenčanje, a Hannah se angažirala u lansiranju novog muzeja Evergreen dok dovodi u pitanje svoju budućnost s Elliotom.

programme.title: Božićne Želje
programme.desc: Organizatorica događaja Christina ima moć čuti želje ljudi. Upoznaje trgovca nekretninama Roberta koji mora priopćiti loše vijesti svom sinu Oliveru.

programme.title: Nepozvane Božićne Gošće
programme.desc: Zaposlenice trgovine čestitkama i prijateljice odluče si uljepšati blagdane tako što će se pojavljivati na zabavama s pozivnicama svojih mušterija.

programme.title: Dar Mira
programme.desc: Udovica Traci gubi svoju vjeru u kršćanstvo, a za njezin drugi Božić koji provodi sama posjećuje grupu za podršku radi utjehe i inspiracije.

programme.title: Šansa Za Božić
programme.desc: Influencerica Christina Chance je oduševljena kada dobije priliku surađivati sa svojim omiljenim brendom, no s time dolaze i brojni izazovi. Hoće li Kristina uspjeti izdržati pod pritiskom?
